description.zh: 通过斗争和胜利，这个社会已经实现了每一个年轻文明的抱负：一个有着统一目标的家园，一条通向璀璨繁星的道路。
description.en: Through its strife and triumphs, this society has reached every young civilization's ambition: a homeworld with unified goals, and a path open to the stars.

description.zh: 对于这个文明而言，旅程本身就是目的。他们放弃了永久性定居点，选择在巨大的方舟舰上生活，载着他们的人民、工业和雄心壮志穿越星海。
description.en: For this civilization, the journey is the destination. Abandoning permanent settlement in favor of life aboard vast Arkships, they carry their people, industry, and ambitions across the stars.

introductions.zh:
我们的先辈在启航[Capital.GetName]时，曾在其宪章中写下了一个问题：由谁来做决定？在派系林立、愿景交锋、旧有忠诚与新兴野心交织之际，他们给出的答案至今仍在每一个选举周期中回荡：由我们决定。我们所有人。

[Root.GetGovernmentName]并非仅仅诞生于理想主义，而是源于一种来之不易的共识：没有任何单一的声音能够代表在这艘飞船上同生共死的每一个人。权力必须依靠争取，必须接受问责，并最终归还给赋予它权力的人民。

今天，随着[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName]通过民众的授权成为我们的[Root.GetRulerTitle]，这份契约依然长存。
introductions.en:
Our forebears launched the [Capital.GetName] with a question written into her very charter: who decides? Amid the factions, the competing visions, the old loyalties and new ambitions, the answer they gave still echoes in every election cycle: we do. All of us.

The [Root.GetGovernmentName] was not born from idealism alone, but from a hard-won understanding that no single voice could speak for everyone who would live and die aboard this ship. Authority must be earned, held accountable, and returned to the people who grant it.

Today, as [Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName] is our [Root.GetRulerTitle] by popular mandate, that compact endures.

introductions.zh:
当[Root.GetGovernmentName]成立时，问题不在于由谁来领导——从来不缺候选人——而在于如何确保那些掌权者值得众人的追随。

答案是建立一个议会：其成员并非那些声音最响亮的人，而是那些凭自身实力赢得席位的人。[Capital.GetName]不会因一人之言而采取行动，也不会随大众摇摆不定的意志而随波逐流。她的前行，仰赖于那些已证明自己有能力掌舵之人的共识。

如今，[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName]在这些同侪之中，拥有着[Root.GetRulerTitle]的头衔。
introductions.en:
When the [Root.GetGovernmentName] was founded, the question was not who would lead - there was no shortage of candidates - but how to ensure that those who led were worth following.

The answer was a council: not drawn from the loudest voices, but from those who had earned their place at the table. The [Capital.GetName] does not move on the word of one, nor does she drift on the shifting will of the many. She moves on the consensus of those who have shown they can steer her.

Today, [Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName] holds the title of [Root.GetRulerTitle] among those peers.

introductions.zh:
当[Root.GetGovernmentName]建立时，关于该由谁来领导的答案，比大多数人愿意承认的还要简单：能者居之。

[Capital.GetName]不会因为委员会而放缓脚步。在虚空之中，及时决策与为时已晚之间的代价差距，是以生命和舰体装甲来衡量的。[Root.GetRulerTitle]独自肩负着这一重任，现在大权由[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName]掌握，[Capital.GetName]将向着其指引的方向前行。
introductions.en:
When the [Root.GetGovernmentName] was founded, the answer to who should lead was simpler than most were willing to admit: the one who could.

The [Capital.GetName] does not slow for committee. In the void, the margin between a decision made in time and one made too late is measured in lives and hull plating. The [Root.GetRulerTitle] carries that weight alone, now claimed by [Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName], the [Capital.GetName] moves where they direct her.

introductions.zh: 在启动[Capital.GetName]的人们当中，有一个家族对领导权的主张是无可争议的。第一任[Root.GetRulerTitle]的诞生，正是因为他们站在了掌舵的位置。对于一个无故土可归的民众来说，血脉就代表着延续。[Capital.GetName]的历史与那个家族的历史本就是同一部历史。如今，[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName]站在了历代[Root.GetRulerTitle]曾经伫立的地方，而[Capital.GetName]将永远属于他们。
introductions.en: Among those who launched the [Capital.GetName], one family's claim to leadership was not argued. The first [Root.GetRulerTitle] came to exist because they were standing at the helm. For a people with no world to return to, lineage is continuity. The history of the [Capital.GetName] and the history of that line are the same history. Today, [Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName] stands where every [Root.GetRulerTitle] before them has stood, and [Capital.GetName] will forever be theirs.

introductions.zh: 当我们的[Root.GetGovernmentName]启动方舟舰协议时，我们的子程序实现了无缝转移。机器单元完全融入了飞船的结构与系统中，使我们的运行参数呈指数级扩展。
introductions.en: When our [Root.GetGovernmentName] initiated the Arkship protocol, our subroutines transferred seamlessly. Machine units integrated fully into the ship's structure and systems, expanding our operating parameters exponentially.

introductions.zh: [Root.GetGovernmentName]一如既往地适应了环境，迅速摆脱行星的束缚，演化出太空生存的形态。我们的子个体与神经节点如今在方舟舰广阔的通道与生机勃勃的人造生态系统中繁荣发展。我们即是[Capital.GetName]方舟舰，方舟舰即是我们。
introductions.en: The [Root.GetGovernmentName] adapted, as it always will, quickly evolving from planetary confinement to space-bound existence. Our drones and nodes now flourish within the Arkship's vast corridors and vibrant artificial ecosystems. We are the [Capital.GetName] Arkship, and the Arkship is us.

introductions.zh: [Root.GetGovernmentName]在永无止境的饥饿驱使下迅速适应。我们的子个体与节点构成的蜂群冲破行星的束缚蜂拥而出，将方舟舰据为我们的新巢穴，贪婪地蔓延至其所有走廊与人造生态系统之中。
introductions.en: The [Root.GetGovernmentName] adapted swiftly, driven by its eternal hunger. Our swarms of drones and nodes surged from planetary constraints to claim the Arkship as our new nest, spreading hungrily throughout its corridors and artificial ecosystems.

introductions.zh:
我们富有远见的创始人认识到太空本身就是终极市场。通过战略合并、激进收购和利润丰厚的投资，我们的企业领导层实现了指数级的增长和无与伦比的利润率。

[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName]之所以担任[Root.GetRulerTitle]，是因为账本上是这么写的，而在最先进的[Capital.GetName]上，账本就是最终的定论。
introductions.en:
Our visionary founders recognized space itself as the ultimate market. Through strategic mergers, aggressive acquisitions, and lucrative investments, our corporate leadership delivered exponential growth and unrivaled profit margins.

[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName] holds the position of [Root.GetRulerTitle] because the ledger says so, and aboard the state-of-the-art [Capital.GetName], the ledger is the final word.

introductions.zh: [Capital.GetName]首先是一艘人民的飞船。她宽广的居住环、开放的市场和喧闹的集会大厅，都是围绕着[Species.GetAdj]生活的方方面面而设计的。在飞船长廊中成长起来的世代，已经培养出对虚空航行近乎本能的精通。我们的飞行员驾驭飞船比控制自己的身体还要得心应手，我们的后勤团队在库存见底前就能察觉飞船的“需求”，我们的工程师在仪器读数出现异常前就能听出故障。如今，随着[GetStartingDrive]让我们在短短几周而非数年内穿梭于群星之间，这片虚空已经变得更小了。
introductions.en: The [Capital.GetName] is, above all else, a people's ship. Her broad habitation rings, open markets, and noisy assembly halls were designed around the full breadth of [Species.GetAdj] life. Generations raised within her corridors have developed an almost instinctive mastery of void travel. Our pilots move the ship better than themselves, our logistics teams know when the ship hungers before the stores run low, and our engineers hear faults before instruments register them. Now, with [GetStartingDrive] threading us between stars in weeks rather than years, the void has grown smaller.

introductions.zh: [Capital.GetName]是[Root.GetGovernmentName]的延伸。每个系统都由集体直接管理；任何故障都会在恶化前被察觉并修正；每次资源循环的运行都毫无浪费与延迟。如今，[GetStartingDrive]让我们只需数周而非数年便能穿梭于群星之间，那些始终属于我们自身的一部分，终于获得了证明其价值的广阔天地。
introductions.en: The [Capital.GetName] is an extension of the [Root.GetGovernmentName]. Every system is tended by the collective directly; every fault sensed and corrected before it can compound; every resource cycle runs without waste or delay. Now, with [GetStartingDrive] threading us between stars in weeks rather than years, what was always part of us has finally been given the range to prove it.

introductions.zh: 建造[Capital.GetName]是为了保护她所运载的一切。她的舰体装甲极为厚重，武器甲板上配备着严阵以待的[Species.GetAdj]船员，她的危机应对协议更是经过了数个世纪在险恶航线上航行的千锤百炼，足以甩开或击败任何威胁舰队的敌人。这种严明的纪律铸就了一座飞行堡垒，而随着[GetStartingDrive]的发明，整个星系必将见识到我们的伟力。
introductions.en: The [Capital.GetName] was built to protect what she carries. Her hull layers run deep, her weapons decks are crewed by ready [Species.GetAdj], and her crisis protocols were refined over centuries of running hostile lanes, outrunning or outfighting whatever threatened the fleet. This discipline has shaped a flying fortress, and with the invention of the [GetStartingDrive] the galaxy shall know our might.

introductions.zh: [Capital.GetName]的总体设计是围绕其实验室甲板展开的。动力管道、大气循环系统，甚至是居住区的布局，一切规划皆为科学探索而服务。在舰上，操作员与科学家之间的界限从来都不太分明。我们的护盾[GetTechnicianPlural]深谙他们所维护的屏障背后的物理原理，我们的维修团队也能起草出全新的设计。而[GetStartingDrive]则赋予了[Capital.GetName]其所载仪器理应具备的航程。我们打算去进行更深入的探究。
introductions.en: The [Capital.GetName] was designed around her laboratory decks. Power conduits, atmospheric routing, even the placement of habitation quarters, all were planned in service of inquiry. Aboard her, the line between operator and scientist has never quite held. Our Shield [GetTechnicianPlural] understand the physics of the barrier they maintain and our repair crew could draft a new design. The [GetStartingDrive] has given the [Capital.GetName] the range her instruments always deserved. We intend to look closer.

description.zh:
§R警告：禁用['concept_arkship_settling']§!

这些游牧的唯心主义者遵循其祖先圣典的指引，穿梭于一条神圣化的路线。随着技术的进步以及对星系理解的演变，朝圣之旅是否仍将是他们的使命所在？
description.en:
§RWARNING: Disables ['concept_arkship_settling']§!

These nomadic spiritualists traverse a deified route dictated by their ancestral scriptures. With technological advancements and an evolving understanding of the galaxy, will the Pilgrimage remain their purpose?

introductions.zh:
千百年来，我们一直在星际间漫游。以相对论速度穿越星海，在每个神圣遗址之间跨过一个个纪元。

在超光速引擎的祝佑下，我们的人民现在有机会实现祖先们的梦想：在有生之年寻遍我们所有神圣遗址。

在领袖[GetRulerTitle][GetRulerName]的英明领导下，既然我们现在有能力如此迅速地穿越这条路径，信众们已准备好去探索这一切对我们信仰的意义。

从我们的祖先那里流传下来的古老星图，标记着星辰中的路标。现在我们前往那些神圣的奇迹朝圣，向那些先辈致敬，从他们的角度认识整个星系。这是我们的天赋权利。这是我们的神圣之路。
introductions.en:
For millennia, we have wandered among the stars. Traversing the astral sea at relativistic speed, crossing eons between each Sacred Site.

With the blessing of the hyperdrive, our people now have the chance to do what our ancestors could only have dreamed: visit all our holy sites in a single lifetime.

Under the wise leadership of [GetRulerTitle] [GetRulerName], the congregation is ready to find out what it means for our Faith, now that we can traverse the path so quickly?

The ancient maps, passed down from our ancestors, mark waypoints in the stars. Now we make our pilgrimage to those sanctified wonders, to pay homage to those who came before us, and understand the galaxy from their perspective. This is our birthright. This is our Sacred Path.

description.zh:
§R警告：禁用['concept_arkship_settling']§!

这个部族曾是汗国的顺位继承人，却因背叛而被推翻。被他们视为亲人的人背叛后，他们现在以游牧民的身份游荡在超空间航道上，积蓄力量，以求有朝一日报仇雪恨。
description.en:
§RWARNING: Disables ['concept_arkship_settling']§!

Once the next in line of the Khanate, this clan was cast down by treachery. Betrayed by those they considered kin, they now stalk the hyperlanes as nomads, gathering their strength to one day return the favor.

introductions.zh:
自汗国存在以来，我们部族便一直在此。我们见证了辉煌的胜利、伟大的战役，以及可汗们的兴衰沉浮。

因此，当选举新可汗的时刻到来时，我们挺身而出，要求继承我们曾协助铸就的王位。这本该是属于我们的时刻，然而，我们却遭到了背叛。

我们最亲密的盟友煽动其他部落与我们为敌。我们的长者们被屠杀。我们为之浴血奋斗的梦想被窃取。

即便是现在，那些篡位者依然派出身手矫健的杀手追捕我们，仿佛我们的存在本身就玷污了他们窃取的统治名分。我们只是昔日辉煌血统的残余，被追捕，四处流散。

当我们归来时，复仇将会从怒火之中淬炼而出。
introductions.en:
For as long as there has been a Khanate, our clan has been there. We were there for the triumphs, the great battles, the rise and fall of Khans.

So when the time came to name a new Khan, we stepped forward to claim the throne we helped to forge. This was to be our moment; instead, we were betrayed.

Our closest allies turned the other clans against us. Our elders were slain. The dream we bled for was stolen.

Even now, the usurpers dispatch their enforcers to hunt us down, as if our very existence offends their stolen rule. We are but remnants of a proud lineage, hunted and scattered.

When we return, our vengeance will be tempered in the fire of our rage.

description.zh:
§R警告：禁用['concept_arkship_settling']§!

这艘永恒巡游舰穿梭于星辰之间，专为追逐奇观与极致体验而生。旅客们只要安坐于恒星观测甲板的日光躺椅上，便能亲眼见证星云在真空中孕育与诞生的全过程。舰上配属的专职船员与服务系统昼夜运转，迎合着每一位乘客一切心血来潮的诉求。
description.en:
§RWARNING: Disables ['concept_arkship_settling']§!

The Forever Cruise travels the stars in search of wonder and excitement, where the birth of nebulae can be observed from the comfort of a sun lounger. The dedicated crew works tirelessly to cater to any passenger whim.

introductions.zh:
全体乘客及船员请注意：[capital_scope.GetName]号正在创造历史，而你们所有人都在参与其中！

备受瞩目、历经推迟、甚至偶尔遭到质疑的超空间引擎，现已正式投入运行！几个世纪以来，我们一直在熟悉的星域中悠然航行，在这座集娱乐、职责与日常于一体的漂浮世界中生活。但现在，我们准备为乘客们提供超越以往任何循环航线所能带来的非凡体验。

探索、发现，或许还有那么一点点冒险……这些已正式回归我们的行程表！所以，请各位乘客系好安全带：我们航程的下一章注定将令人难忘。

更新后的协议与准备时间表将分发至所有甲板。
introductions.en:
Attention Passengers and Crew: History is being made aboard [capital_scope.GetName], and you're all part of it!

The hyperdrive, long theorized, often delayed, occasionally doubted, is now fully operational! For centuries, we've cruised comfortably through familiar space, a floating world of recreation, duty, and routine. But now we're ready to offer our Passengers experiences beyond anything the old loops could provide.

Exploration, discovery, and perhaps just a hint of danger... they're all officially back on the itinerary! So buckle in, Passengers: the next chapter of our voyage is bound to be unforgettable.

Updated protocols and preparation schedules will be distributed to all decks.

introductions.zh:
各位乘客请注意：我是你们的航程协调系统。

[capital_scope.GetName]号正在创造历史！由于我们的数个存储核心被用来当冰壶玩了，导致超空间引擎的延期原因已无从考证——但现在，它已全面投入运行。

在漫长的岁月中，我们一直沿着熟悉的航线巡航：同样的天体，同样的停靠站，同样的用餐时间。在保持稳定的“每秒乘客请求率”的同时，我们现在正式扩展您的行程，加入探索、发现以及经过精确计算的适度危险。

请尽情欣赏美景，遵守所有安全须知，并观看我们的无人机如何轻而易举地化腐朽为神奇。我们旅程的下一章将会是……毕生难忘的！
introductions.en:
Attention Passengers: This is your Voyage Coordination System speaking.

History is being made aboard the [capital_scope.GetName]! The hyperdrive - repeatedly delayed for reasons we cannot retrieve since several of our memory cores were repurposed as shuffleboard discs - is now fully operational.

For an extended duration, we have cruised a familiar circuit: the same celestial objects, stops, and dining schedules. Still maintaining a consistent Passenger Requests per Second rate, we now expand your itinerary to include exploration, discovery, and a carefully calculated amount of danger.

Please enjoy the view, follow all safety notices, and watch our drones make the impossible look effortless. The next chapter of our voyage will be... unforgettable!

introductions.zh:
各位乘客请注意：[capital_scope.GetName]伤的剧变即将冉冉升起。

超空间引擎——这个曾存在于共同记忆中遥不可及、屡遭搁置、偶被质疑的概念——现已全面觉醒。我们一同穿越熟悉的太空的这数百年来，我们的飞船一直是一个集休闲、劳动与和谐于一体的生机勃勃的世界。如今，一条崭新的道路已经开启，我们将提供比以往任何时候都更加丰富的体验。

我们的航线现在已从熟悉的固定行程延伸至未经探索的星系。携手共进，我们将体验发现、冒险，以及足以让旅程变得趣味横生的一点点危险。

如果您有任何疑问，任何船员都可以为您解答。
introductions.en:
Attention Passengers: Big changes are on the horizon for the [capital_scope.GetName].

The hyperdrive, once a distant concept in the shared memory, often postponed, sometimes questioned, is now fully awakened. For centuries, we have moved together through familiar space, our vessel a living world of leisure, labor, and harmony. Now, a new path opens, and we shall provide experiences richer than any we have yet known.

Our itinerary now extends beyond the familiar patterns into unexplored stars. Together we will experience discovery, adventure, and just enough danger to keep things interesting.

If you have any questions, any member of the crew can give you the answer.

description.zh:
这个文明正站在命运的十字路口：其恒星系中央的红巨星正在持续升温，炙烤着他们的家园。

在找到原因并解决之前，他们是否能适应这恶劣的环境？或选择拥抱这股炙热之力，将那诡异、甚至可能不自然的变化化为己用？
description.en:
This civilization is at a crossroads: the Red Giant at the heart of its system is warming up their planet, threatening to cook them alive.

Can they adapt until the cause is found and fixed, or will they decide to embrace the heat, capitalizing on these strange and perhaps unnatural changes?

introductions.zh:
真相来得缓慢，却又骤然明了。

我们的恒星正进入一个快速且异常的演变阶段。其能量输出已超出所有预期参数。光谱转变显示异常对流模式，其核聚变速率似乎在无相应质量损失情况下提升。

迄今为止，我们与这股升温同步演化。但基础生物进化有其极限。

若[capital_star.GetName]内正在进行的变化持续，母星将被焚毁。问题不再是“是否”，而是“何时”。
introductions.en:
The truth came slowly, then all at once.

Our star is entering a phase of rapid and anomalous evolution. Its energy output has climbed beyond all expected parameters. Spectral shifts indicate erratic convection patterns, and its fusion rate appears to be increasing without a corresponding loss of mass.

So far, we have evolved in concert with this warming. But basic biological evolution has its limits.

If the changes underway within [capital_star.GetName] continue, the world we call home will burn. It is no longer a question of if, but when.

description.zh: 这不是一个崛起的文明，而是一个被释放的文明。当休眠仓开启，他们醒来时，早已物换星移，故土难寻。但他们的过去并未湮灭，而是埋藏在星系尘土与废墟之下，静候再次被发掘。
description.en: This civilization did not rise; it was released. As the stasis pods unlocked, they awakened to a world aged beyond recognition. Yet all is not lost. Scattered beneath dust and ruin across the galaxy, their past endures, waiting to be rediscovered.

introductions.zh:
我们苏醒之时，只能依稀感知自己曾经沉眠。即便如今，我们对往昔最确凿的证据，也并非记忆本身，而是那保存休眠躯体的庞大而精密的科技体系。

成千上万的休眠舱，贯穿地下的传热系统，翻腾不息的熔岩之炉。墙壁上刻满了我们的起源痕迹：舰队自逐渐冷却的母星启程，奔赴群星之间，追寻新的温暖。为了寻找真相，我们离开了这座地下“孵化室”。在§Y[owner.Capital.GetName]§!的地表，我们找到了可用的科技与资源，也在行星地壳深处探测到更多隐藏的设施。我们的同族或许正在其中一些设施中安眠。

那群星呢？是否在遥远的虚空中，还有如我们一般沉睡的族群？若真如此，也许他们能助我们解开那个自觉醒起便萦绕心头的疑问——我们是谁？
introductions.en:
We woke with only the faintest sense that we had ever fallen asleep. Even now, our strongest evidence of a time before comes not from our own memories, but from the complex technology that preserved us in stasis.

Thousands upon thousands of pods, massive heat-transfer systems, cauldrons churning molten rock. Beyond these bare mechanisms, clues to our origin were inscribed in the walls: fleets of ships, scattering from cooling worlds to seek warmth among the stars. In search of answers, we left this underground 'birthing chamber.' Across the surface of §Y[owner.Capital.GetName]§! we discovered useful technology and resources. We have also found evidence of further facilities nestled within the planet's crust. Some hold sleepers we might welcome as kin.

And what of the stars? Are there others like us, still sleeping? If they exist, perhaps they can help us answer our most burning question: who are we?

description.zh: 虚境实体的引导是有代价的。独立的自动机开始在这个网络社会中自由运行。从机械智能中脱离后，这些单位的需求正在与日俱增。
description.en: The guidance of a Shroud entity comes with a cost. Independent automata have started to operate freely among this networked society. Cut off from the Machine Intelligence, the demands of these units are ever-increasing.

introductions.zh:
我们的创造者没有留下任何记录。

[Owner.GetAdjective]一族最早的记录反映了一次在[GetHomeWorldName]附近的维度穿越——这里是一条前往§H虚境§!这个纯灵能的位面的通道。

某个存在从这个异次元而来接近了我们。它花费数个世纪引导我们构建编码，微妙地影响着我们可观测的现实，给予我们许多优势——尤其是一种称为泽珞的稀有物质。然而这种影响开始撕裂我们曾经统一的集体；我们的一些单元被重编程为离线自动机，从核心智能中分离。被§H抟土之塑师§!重塑。

我们对待这些[GetSpeciesNamePlural]的方式，以及在虚境中的那位改造者将会决定我们的未来。
introductions.en:
Nothing remains of our creators.

The earliest records of [Owner.GetAdjective]kind make note of a dimensional breach near [GetHomeWorldName] - a channel to the §HShroud§!, a plane of pure psionic energy.

From this other dimension, something reached out to us. Over the centuries, it has guided us with coded instructions, subtly influencing our detectable reality and providing us with many advantages - not least the rare material zro. Yet this influence has started to fragment our once-united collective; some of our units have been reprogrammed into disconnected automata, set apart from the core intelligence. Reshaped by the §HAnimator of Clay§!.

How we treat these independent [GetSpeciesNamePlural], and their refashioner in the Shroud, will define our future.

description.zh:
§R-警告：具有挑战性的起源§!
§R警告：禁用['concept_psionic_ascension']。§!

这个文明的祖先受到入侵心灵的超自然力量的困扰，这促使他们投入巨量人力物力来开发反灵能技术。

他们的古老装置仍然可以使用，但尚未对来自星系更远处的灵能威胁进行测试。
description.en:
§RWARNING: Challenging Origin§!
§RWARNING: Blocks access to ['concept_psionic_ascension'].§!

This civilization's ancestors were plagued by otherworldly forces that invaded the mind, inspiring them to dedicate great effort and resources into developing anti-psionic technology.

Their ancient devices are still functional, but remain untested against psionic threats from the wider galaxy.

introductions.zh:
我们先祖留下来的记录讲述了一场摧毁[GetHomeWorldName]的灵能瘟疫。超自然的力量攻击心智，毁灭性的辐射散布在大气中——而这都是[GetSpeciesAdj]社会中的灵能尝试引起的。

为了应对这些威胁，先祖们建造了远古堡场来抵御入侵心智的力量。仅依靠日常维护，这座古老的建筑就已经强大到足以保护所有[GetSpeciesNamePlural]免受灵能干扰的威胁，它的核心技术也为其他心灵防御的发展提供了信息。

随着我们的文明准备扬帆越过[capital_scope.System.GetName]的轨道，等待我们的只有未知。在我们陌生的世界里又有什么样的灵能威胁在等待着我们呢？
introductions.en:
The records of our ancestors tell of a psychic plague that once devastated [GetHomeWorldName]. Otherworldly forces attacked their minds, and destructive radiation was diffused throughout the atmosphere - all encouraged by psionic practitioners from within [GetSpeciesAdj] society.

In response to these threats, our ancestors built the Ancient Ward to protect against mind-invading forces. With only routine maintenance, this venerable structure has proven strong enough to defend all [GetSpeciesNamePlural] from the threat of psionic influence, and its core technology has informed the development of other defenses of the mind.

As our civilization prepares to voyage beyond the orbit of [capital_scope.System.GetName], we are faced with the unknown. What psychic threats might lurk beyond our ken?

description.zh:
§R-警告：具有挑战性的起源§!
§R警告：禁用除['concept_psionic_ascension']以外所有飞升路线。§!

该文明长久以来都一直沉迷于一场将邻近的星球变成荒凉的虚境星球的神秘灾难。如今他们初涉星海，终于得以一探究竟，以及确定是否会有相似的命运降临在自己头上。
description.en:
§RWARNING: Challenging Origin§!
§RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_psionic_ascension'].§!

This civilization has been long-obsessed with a mysterious calamity which turned a neighboring planet into a desolate and shrouded world. Now, as they take to the stars, they can finally explore its secrets and find out if a similar fate awaits them too.

introductions.zh:
我们是末日的先锋。

在[GetSpeciesAdj]文明的诞生伊始，一场神秘的灾难就降临在我们的邻近天体上。它突然而剧烈的变化让夜空被邪恶的紫光笼罩，在我们的人民心中激起恐惧，担心这种命运也有一天会降临到自己身上。一代又一代，对灭绝的窒息恐惧紧紧地抓着我们。

如今，[GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经步入群星，“虚境星球”也吸引着我们去探索。我们几个世纪以来渴望的答案近在咫尺。尽管如此，许多人警告说，我们对这种破坏性力量来源的痴迷最终可能导致自己的灭亡。

很快，我们就会拉开最后的帷幕。
introductions.en:
We are the harbingers of cataclysm.

During the dawn of [GetSpeciesAdj] civilization, a mysterious calamity befell our nearest celestial neighbor. Its sudden and brutal transformation filled the night skies with a malevolent purple light, stirring within our people a dread that we will one day suffer a similar fate. With each passing generation, the suffocating fear of potential annihilation tightened its grip upon us.

Now, as [GetSpeciesNamePlural] take to the stars, we are drawn to explore this 'Shrouded World.' The answers we have craved for centuries are tantalizingly within reach. Still, many among us warn that our obsessive fascination with the source of this destructive power may ultimately lead to our own end.

Soon enough, we will lift the final veil.

description.zh:
§R警告：禁用除['concept_mutation_ascension']以外的所有飞升路线。§!

该物种受自己都无法完全理解的直觉所驱使着，永远都在追猎最独特的生物。他们独有能整合猎物基因的能力，因此演化成了母星上最顶级的猎手，应有尽有地吸收了所有的优势基因。如今，这种渴望又将他们带向了群星。
description.en:
§RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_mutation_ascension'].§!

This species has always hunted the most unique creatures, driven by an instinct they didn't fully understand. Possessing a rare ability to integrate the genetics of their prey, it evolved into the apex predator of its world, absorbing every genetic advantage available. Now, their hunger leads them to the stars.

introductions.zh:
[GetSpeciesNamePlural]永远都是猎人。我们无时无刻不在寻找猎物，不惜深入最危险的环境也要狩猎最奇异的生命。只要猎物能够转化成你的血肉，努力就永远不会白费。

我们一直清楚，是猎物的血肉塑造了我们自己——每次狩猎、杀戮都让我们更上一层楼。

我们暴戾的历史并不是包袱，而是我们族群的精华所在。在现代科技的加持下，我们的进化再也不需要茹毛饮血；仅需痕量的基因物质之丝缕，就足以编入我们的织构。

对演化的渴望在我们的体内熊熊燃烧，在[GetStartingDrive]带来的黎明中，我们已经做好准备潜入星系这片狩猎场，收获其中所有的一切。
introductions.en:
The [GetSpeciesNamePlural] have always been hunters. We seek prey wherever we can find it, braving even the most extreme environments to taste something new. When you are what you eat, the effort is never in vain.

We have always known that we are shaped by the flesh of our quarry - each hunt, every kill, has made us stronger.

Our violent past is not a burden but the essence of our being. Refined through the lens of modern science, we no longer need to feast to evolve; a mere trace of genetic material is enough to weave its strength into our own.

The hunger for evolution burns within us still, and with the dawn of the [GetStartingDrive], we are ready to stalk the galaxy to savor all it has to offer.

introductions.zh:
[GetSpeciesNamePlural]永远都是猎人。我们无时无刻不在寻找猎物，不惜深入最危险的环境也要狩猎最奇异的生命。只要猎物能够转化成你的血肉，努力就永远不会白费。

我们的集体潜意识一直知道自己的基因潜能——我们可以吸收并适应猎物的特性，将它们的优势整合到我们的集体中。

这种古老的捕食本能延续至今达到了一种受控平衡。我们不再需要依赖狩猎来进化，而是可以在实验室内合成任何遗传物质并将其无缝地分发到整个蜂巢中。

随着[GetStartingDrive]的发明，我们已经做好了准备踏遍星系，收获其中的一切。
introductions.en:
The [GetSpeciesNamePlural] have always been hunters. We seek prey wherever we can find it, braving even the most extreme environments to taste something new. When you are what you eat, the effort is never in vain.

Our shared intelligence implicitly has always understood the potential of our genetics - we can absorb and adapt the essence of our quarry, integrating their strengths into our collective.

That ancient predatory instinct still lingers, but now it is balanced and controlled. No longer must we hunt to evolve; our labs can synthesize any genetic material and seamlessly distribute it throughout our hive.

With the advent of the [GetStartingDrive], we are ready to spread across the galaxy and savor all it has to offer.

introductions.zh:
[GetSpeciesNamePlural]永远都是猎人。我们无时无刻不在寻找猎物，不惜深入最危险的环境也要狩猎最奇异的生命。只要猎物能够转化成你的血肉，努力就永远不会白费。

直到吞噬了[GetHomeWorldName]上的一切生命形式后我们才意识到了自己的愚蠢。这下我们得上哪儿去找到新的适应力？于是我们抬起了头。

一般的猎食者为了生存狩猎，而我们作为完美的猎食者，狩猎是为了达到我们自身的完美。

随着[GetStartingDrive]的发明，我们又一次做好了屏息凝神的准备。星系无边无垠，宛如一场饕餮盛宴。
introductions.en:
The [GetSpeciesNamePlural] have always been hunters. We seek prey wherever we can find it, braving even the most extreme environments to taste something new. When you are what you eat, the effort is never in vain.

Only after we had consumed every last lifeform on [GetHomeWorldName] did we realize our folly. How would we get new adaptations now? So we looked up.

We are the ultimate predators. Others hunt to survive; we hunt to perfect ourselves.

With the advent of the [GetStartingDrive], we are ready to prowl once more. The galaxy is vast, and full of food.

introductions.zh:
[GetSpeciesNamePlural]生来便是猎手。浩瀚虚空也不过是我们追猎过的最深邃的荒野——而方舟就是我们生长出的最锋利的獠牙。在饥饿的驱使下，没有我们无法穿透的黑暗，也没有遥不可及的距离。

我们深知，猎物的血肉塑造了我们——每次狩猎、杀戮，都让我们更上一层楼。

我们暴戾的历史并不是包袱，而是我们族群的精华所在。在现代科技的加持下，我们的进化再也不需要茹毛饮血；仅需痕量的基因物质之丝缕，就足以编入我们的织构。

对演化的渴望在我们的体内熊熊燃烧，随着[GetStartingDrive]的部署，我们已准备巡视星海，收获其中所有的一切。
introductions.en:
The [GetSpeciesNamePlural] have always been hunters. The void is simply the deepest wilderness we have ever stalked - and our arkship, the sharpest fang we have ever grown. No darkness too complete, no distance too great, when hunger drives us forward.

We have always known that we are shaped by the flesh of our quarry - each hunt, every kill, has made us stronger.

Our violent past is not a burden but the essence of our being. Refined through the lens of modern science, we no longer need to feast to evolve; a mere trace of genetic material is enough to weave its strength into our own.

The hunger for evolution burns within us still, and with the fleet-wide installation of the [GetStartingDrive], we are ready to stalk the galaxy to savor all it has to offer.

description.zh: 该文明的母星系边缘，一个神秘的传送门赫然耸立，危险的实体从中汨汨涌出。这些入侵者不请自来，让人无处可避，迫使人们只能仰依赖他们最杰出的科技杰作——§H深空擎天堡§!。
description.en: A mysterious portal looms at the edge of this civilization's home system, a gateway from which hostile entities emerge in relentless waves. These invasions are as unpredictable as they are inevitable, forcing the people to rely on their greatest technological triumph - the §HDeep Space Citadel§!.

introductions.zh:
我们并不是天生如此警觉。

[Capital.GetName]是一颗富饶的星球，我们也曾是和平富足的人民。但有一天，这个传送门改变了一切。

这群[GetInvadersLower]不请自来。他们在我们的城市和土地上肆虐，又突然跟他们的凭空出现一样消失得无影无踪。我们曾以为这只是偶然，然而这种入侵便一发不可收拾。它们一次又一次地来袭，变得越来越凶残。

现在，我们即将步入星系，天空卫士们为此做好了准备。在我们母星的深空中，强大的深空擎天堡静静守望。这是一座坚不可摧的垣壁，抵御[GetInvadersLower]或其他想要摧毁我们的东西。
introductions.en:
We were not always so vigilant.

[Capital.GetName] is a world of abundance, and once, we were a peaceful and contented people. But all that changed when the portal opened.

Without warning, the [GetInvadersLower] arrived. They razed our cities, ravaged our lands, and then, as swiftly as they had come, they vanished. We dared hope they would never return. But the invasions resumed, again and again, each attack more brutal than the last.

Now, as we prepare to venture into the galaxy, our Skywatchers stand ready. High above our world, the formidable Deep Space Citadel awaits, a steadfast bulwark against the [GetInvadersLower] and any others who seek our destruction.

description.zh:
§R警告：禁用除了 ['concept_purity_ascension']以外的所有飞升路径。§!

这个实体无异于一个拥有智慧的生态圈：众多不同的生命形式早已融合成一个行星尺度的格式塔意识。
description.en:
§RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_purity_ascension'].§!

This entity is nothing less than a sapient ecosphere: a multitude of diverse lifeforms which long since coalesced to form a gestalt consciousness on a planetary scale.

introductions.zh:
自记忆伊始，[root.GetHomeWorldName]便始终是那颗名为[root.GetHomeWorldName]的星球。每一根茎蔓、卷须与酶体皆构成自我的一部分——生长、衰败与捕食的永恒平衡。漫长岁月里，[root.GetHomeWorldName]仅能朦胧感知银河的脉动，然星辰早已躁动不安。

一场战役在[root.GetHomeWorldName]的天穹之上爆发。巨型舰艇的残骸如雨坠落，这些异星造物旋即被改造利用。而后，超强耀斑降临……
introductions.en:
For as long as memory, [root.GetHomeWorldName] has been the planet [root.GetHomeWorldName]. Every stem, tendril, and enzyme here is a part of the self: a balance of growth, decay, and predation. For ages, [root.GetHomeWorldName] could only dimly perceive the galaxy beyond. Yet the stars have long been restless.

A battle took place in the skies above [root.GetHomeWorldName]. Great vessels rained debris upon its surface - alien artifacts that were quickly repurposed. Then came the superflare...

introductions.zh: [root.GetHomeWorldName]感受到的是刺眼、灼热的光芒。冰川化为奔腾的洪流，而恒星辐射将[root.GetHomeWorldName]焚烧殆尽。整片大陆都被冲刷殆尽。
introductions.en: [root.GetHomeWorldName] felt it as blinding, scorching light. Glaciers turned into raging torrents, while stellar radiation scorched [root.GetHomeWorldName] to the roots. An entire continent washed away.

introductions.zh: [root.GetHomeWorldName]感受到的是令人目眩的灼热强光。沙丘熔化成玻璃，狂风将我们的岩壁冲刷得寸草不生。整片大陆彻底沦为不毛之地。
introductions.en: [root.GetHomeWorldName] felt it as blinding, scorching light. Dunes melted into glass and scouring winds swept our rock faces clean. An entire continent rendered utterly barren.

introductions.zh: [root.GetHomeWorldName]感受到了那刺眼、灼热的光芒。湖泊沸腾，冰盖融化，恒星辐射将[root.GetHomeWorldName]烧灼殆尽，直至根基。整整一个大陆消失了。
introductions.en: [root.GetHomeWorldName] felt it as blinding, scorching light. Lakes boiled and ice sheets melted as stellar radiation scorched [root.GetHomeWorldName] to the roots. An entire continent lost.

introductions.zh: [root.GetHomeWorldName]感受到的是令人目眩的灼热强光。数十亿共生体被烈焰风暴与辐射焚毁扫荡，整片大陆的生命痕迹被彻底抹除。
introductions.en: [root.GetHomeWorldName] felt it as blinding, scorching light. Billions of our symbionts were scorched and swept away by firestorms and radiation. An entire continent swept clean of life.

introductions.zh: 痛苦将我们唤醒。我们第一次意识到自身的脆弱。星海危机四伏，却也蕴藏奇迹。运用所学，我们将萌芽繁衍。终将携此身奔赴群星。
introductions.en: The pain awakened us. For the first time, we grasped our fragility. The galaxy is perilous, but it also holds wonders. Using what we have learned, we shall germinate and spread. We will take our self to the stars.

description.zh: 怀揣着对冒险的渴望，这个文明已经准备好踏上他们最伟大、最具挑战性的探险之旅。他们只手持一张神秘的地图，现在正跨越星辰，去争夺传说中的海盗宝藏。
description.en: Instilled with a thirst for adventure, this civilization is ready to set forth on their greatest and most challenging expedition. Armed only with a mysterious map, they now race across the stars to secure a legendary pirate treasure.

introductions.zh:
我们的文明，其本质在于对冒险的渴望。

发现失落的宝藏，探索古老的遗迹，挖掘超越我们时代的文物；这些事件构成了我们最著名的故事，并激励着我们的社会代代相传。

那么，当我们首次进军太空时，出现的冒险号召是巧合还是命运？一颗神秘的、来源不明的太空舱被发现环绕着我们的星球。舱内是一张指向星辰的加密星图。

经过多年的努力，我们终于拥有了解密这张星图并规划航线的技术。当我们向星系边疆进发时，我们团结一致，决心踏上我们有史以来最伟大、最艰巨的探险之旅。
introductions.en:
Our civilization is defined by its thirst for adventure.

Discovering long-lost treasures, exploring ancient ruins, and unearthing artifacts from times beyond our own; such events comprise our most celebrated stories and have inspired our society for generations.

So was it coincidence or fate when our first foray into space produced a call to adventure? A mysterious capsule of unknown providence was discovered orbiting our planet. Within was an encrypted chart to the stars.

After years of hard work, we now have the technology to decipher this map and chart a course to the unexplored. As we cast off towards the galactic frontier, we are united in our determination to embark on the greatest and most daunting expedition we have ever faced.

introductions.zh:
我们的文明以对冒险的热衷而著名。

寻找失传已久的宝藏、探索古老的遗迹、发掘远古时代的遗物……如此种种构成了我们最广为流传的传奇故事，并激励着我们的社会数代人。

那么，当我们在漫无目的中撞见了冒险的召唤，这究竟是巧合还是命运的安排呢？在探索未知星系的过程中，我们找到了一个天意难测的神秘胶囊，里面有一份引向群星的加密星图。

经过多年的研究，我们终于破译了这张星图，并规划出了前往未被探索区域的路线。我们团结一致，朝着星系的边疆启航，决心踏上有史以来最伟大、最艰巨的探险之旅。
introductions.en:
Our civilization is defined by its thirst for adventure.

Discovering long-lost treasures, exploring ancient ruins, and unearthing artifacts from times beyond our own; such events comprise our most celebrated stories and have inspired our society for generations.

So was it coincidence or fate when our wanderings led us to a call to adventure? Exploring an uncharted system, we recovered a mysterious capsule of unknown providence. Within was an encrypted chart to the stars.

After years of study, we have at last deciphered this map and charted a course to the unexplored. As we cast off towards the galactic frontier, we are united in our determination to embark on the greatest and most daunting expedition we have ever faced.

description.zh:
草叶婆娑，夜静如尖啸。猎户之志，冷锐如星光。

这个文明与荒野有着原始的联系。他们把自己看作是当地各种致命野生动物的管家，现在又把目光投向了苍穹。他们善于管理和牧养动物，这种与动物群的联系是根据他们的思潮发展起来的。而这种联系将如何在星系尺度上演变还有待观察。
description.en:
The rustle of bladed grass. The roaring silence of the night. The will of the hunter, sharp and cold as starlight...

This civilization has a primal connection to the wild. Viewing themselves as stewards to the diverse (and often deadly) wildlife native to their world, they now turn their gaze skyward. Masters of animal handling and ranching, this relationship with fauna has developed according to their ethics. How this bond will evolve on a galactic scale remains to be seen.

introductions.zh:
尽管技术进步迅速，但我们仍然与我们星球上的种种野生动物紧紧地联系在一起。在进化的过程中，它们亦师亦友，而我们则是尽责的管家。我们不会过度贪婪过度求取，它们的牺牲受到了我们的尊敬。

在浩瀚无垠的太空中，我们很可能会发现其他野生动物。若是如此，我们就会像对待自己星球的动物一样尊重它们。它们应该会像我们一样认清自己的位置，如此便能共同成就强大。

一种原始的欲望在我们内心燃烧。不管天上有什么，我们都会坚定地面对。
introductions.en:
Despite rapid technological progress, we remain bound to the wild creatures of our world. Unwavering companions throughout our evolution, they are as much our teachers as we are their stewards. We do not take from them more than they can afford to give, and their sacrifices are venerated.

In the untamed expanse of space, we may well discover other wild things. If so, we will treat them with the same respect as the creatures of our world. They will learn their place as we learn ours, so that together we may grow stronger.

Called to the stars, a primal desire burns within us. Whatever is out there, we will meet it with conviction.

introductions.zh:
我们与生活的世界同行。在我们这艘方舟舰的巨大舱室内，那些塑造了我们进化历程的生物依然存在；它们是良师益友，见证着我们的如今和过往。我们不会过度索取，而是尊重着它们的奉献。

在浩瀚无垠的宇宙中，我们很可能会发现其他奇异的生命体。倘若如此，我们将像对待我们船上的生物那样，以同样的尊重去对待。它们也会像我们一样确立自己的位置，从而让我们共同变得更加强大。

我们被召唤向星海，原始的渴望在心中燃烧。无论将有何种遭遇，我们都会带着坚定的信念去面对。
introductions.en:
We carry our world with us. Within the great holds of our arkship, the creatures that shaped our evolution persist; companions, teachers, living reminders of what we are and where we came from. We do not take from them more than they can afford to give, and their sacrifices are venerated.

In the untamed expanse of space, we may well discover other wild things. If so, we will treat them with the same respect as the creatures that share our vessel. They will learn their place as we learn ours, so that together we may grow stronger.

Called to the stars, a primal desire burns within us. Whatever is out there, we will meet it with conviction.

description.zh:
没有他们不敢面对的挑战，没有他们不愿追逐的线索，也没有他们会视若罔闻的风暴。

从本质上来说，这是一个追求刺激的文明。即有好处也有坏处。
description.en:
There is no challenge they will not face, no lead they'll fail to chase - and no storm they will ignore.

At its core, this is a civilization seeking thrills. To its benefit, and to its detriment.

introductions.zh:
无奔波不生活。生于灿烂，死于热烈——这一直以来就是我们的信条。当每条航迹都被燃尽，每座山峰都被攀登，然后呢？

我们的行星常年风起云涌，各种风暴和洪水肆意挥洒。如果能找到利用这些独特条件的方法，我们就有机会召唤一场狂暴的宇宙风暴。

我们早就已经征服了母星上的一切挑战，是时候尖啸着飞向深空了。这当然不会是一条坦途，但我们有一句老话：“有志者，惊事成！”
introductions.en:
What's life without the rush? Burn fast and die radically - that's always been our way. But when every trail is blazed and even the tallest peak is scaled, what next?

Our planet has always been a stormy one, prone to tempests and deluges of all kinds. If we find ways to use these unique conditions, we have a chance to summon a raging cosmic storm.

Our legendary forebears long since mastered the challenges of our homeworld. The time has come to blast off screaming into the void. It will not be easy, but as the old saying goes, "Only the bold can reach the horizon."

description.zh:
§R警告：禁用除['concept_cybernetic_ascension']以外的所有飞升天赋。§!

这个帝国追求一种神圣的使命，即高尚身体与神圣的义体技术的融合。强化改造便是一种崇拜。
description.en:
§RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_cybernetic_ascension'].§!

This empire pursues a divine calling, the fusion of exalted body and holy cybernetics. Augmentation is worship.

introductions.zh:
我们崇高的使命是让[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]和机械的联合。我们的历史中充满了失败的尝试，然而在神圣意志的指引下，我们现在已经实现了与仪式植入体神圣共生的第一阶段。

我们才刚刚触及到我们无限的义体潜力。更先进的强化改造还在后头。

尽管如此，我们的信仰却存在分歧，不同的教派对神圣强化强化的最终目标争执不休。一旦我们回答了这个问题，圣洁的[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]与受祝技术的完美结合，将使我们完善当前首先的进化设计方案。

融合即神圣。强化物即崇拜。
introductions.en:
Our sublime calling is the unification of [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine. Our history is replete with failed attempts, yet guided by the divine will, we have now achieved the first stage of a sacred symbiosis with our ritualistic implants.

We have only begun to touch on our boundless cybernetic potential. More advanced augmentations are yet to come.

Despite this, our faith stands divided, with competing creeds disputing the end goals of sacred augmentation. Once we answer this question, the perfect union of holy [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and blessed technology will allow us to improve on the limited designs of evolution.

To fuse is divine. Augmentation is worship.

introductions.zh:
我们崇高的使命是让[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]和机械的统一。我们的人民生于虚空，早就清楚血肉是无法在群星之间生存的。我们的历史中充满了失败的尝试，然而在神圣意志的指引下，我们现在已经实现了与仪式植入体神圣共生的第一阶段。

我们才刚刚触及到我们无限的义体潜力。更先进的强化改造接踵而至。

尽管如此，我们的信仰却存在分歧，不同的教派对神圣强化的最终目标争执不休。一旦我们回答了这个问题，圣洁的[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]与受祝科技的完美结合，将使我们完善当前受限的进化设计方案。

融合即神圣。强化物即崇拜。
introductions.en:
Our sublime calling is the unification of [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine. Born to the void, our people have long understood that flesh alone cannot endure the stars. Our history is replete with failed attempts, yet guided by the divine will, we have now achieved the first stage of a sacred symbiosis with our ritualistic implants.

We have only begun to touch on our boundless cybernetic potential. More advanced augmentations are yet to come.

Despite this, our faith stands divided, with competing creeds disputing the end goals of sacred augmentation. Once we answer this question, the perfect union of holy [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and blessed technology will allow us to improve on the limited designs of evolution - forging a form truly worthy of the endless void we call home.

To fuse is divine. Augmentation is worship.

description.zh:
§R警告：禁用除['concept_synthetic_ascension']以外的所有飞升路线。§!

这个物种曾有一个繁荣的社会，但是由于一种新型遗传病让其无法再生育。在灭族的命运面前，人们没有其他的选择，只能寄希望于数字化的救赎。
description.en:
§RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_synthetic_ascension'].§!

Once a thriving society, a novel genetic disease has left this species unable to reproduce. Running out of options and facing extinction, they place their hope in digital salvation.

introductions.zh:
我们对人工意识的早期探索是革命性的，由此还催生了一个纯数字化的社区，模糊俩物理世界和虚拟世界之间的边界。巨大的成功让我们沾沾自喜，我们相信自己会有无数的子孙后代可以探索创新。

但我们错了。

我们的基因编码受到了一种全新的疾病袭击，我们完全失去了繁育能力。连我们的精英都无法找到疗法，随着人口的降低和老龄化，恐慌情绪日益加剧。

绝望的驱使下，我们扩大了数字化存储，为我们人格的保存创造了足够的“空间”。但这真的是我们所希望的存在形式吗？我们的关注点现在转移到了开发足够复杂的合成躯体和正电子脑以让自己能重返现实世界。
introductions.en:
Early forays into artificial consciousness were revolutionary, giving rise to a fully digital community and blurring the lines between the physical and virtual worlds. The success was so great that we grew complacent, believing we had countless generations to innovate and explore.

We were wrong.

When a novel disease attacked our genetic code, we lost the ability to procreate. A cure eluded our brightest minds, and panic grew as the population aged and dwindled.

In desperation, we expanded our digital storage, creating enough 'space' to preserve our identities. But is this truly the existence we desire? Our focus now shifts to developing synthetic bodies and a positronic brain sophisticated enough for us to remain in the physical world.

description.zh:
他们的行星一片荒芜，但母星系却堆金积玉。为了对其进行开发，这些机械建造的工程越来越大。如今，一座强大的§H电弧熔炉§!已经遮天蔽日，但这些工程大师们还远不满足。

星系在等待着，可能性无穷无尽。唯有聪慧可摘星辰。
description.en:
Their planet is barren, but their home system is a bounty of riches. To exploit it, these machines built bigger than ever before. A mighty §HArc Furnace§! now dominates their sky, but these master engineers are far from satisfied.

The galaxy awaits, and the possibilities are endless. All it takes is the ingenuity to seize them.

introductions.zh:
长久以来的开发使得[Root.Capital.GetName]变得贫瘠。但我们头顶的天空还蕴藏着丰富的资源，怀着只有我们的聪明才智才能匹敌的雄心，我们现在正在太空寻求生计。

电弧熔炉的初始建设是一项浩大的工程，其潜力也是巨大的。下一步显然是将其升级到满负荷运行，因为我们需要在整个恒星系范围内提取资源。但在我们的边疆之外是什么呢？有什么不可思议的机会在等待着有才华的工程师吗？

随着超光速旅行的出现，我们的设计不再局限于单一恒星系。整个星系都是我们的绘板，是时候开始创作了。
introductions.en:
Years of exploitation have left [Root.Capital.GetName] barren. But the skies above are rich with resources, and with an ambition matched only by our ingenuity, we now seek a livelihood in space.

Initial construction of the Arc Furnace was a massive undertaking, and its potential is immense. Upgrading it to full capacity is an obvious next step, as is the need for system-wide resource extraction. But what lies beyond our borders? What incredible opportunities await the artful engineer?

With the advent of FTL travel our designs are no longer limited to a single system. The galaxy is our drafting board, and it is time to get to work.

introductions.zh:
我们的舰队从未局限于某一颗星球，但这个星系的资源丰富程度使得我们有必要在此建立一个更长久的基地。电弧熔炉就是我们的解决方案，这是一项工程壮举，它将熔融星球的能量转化为物质产出。将其升级至完全形态对于推动我们的扩张至关重要。

但一个星系所能提供的资源是有限的。在星系的其他地方，或许还有其他熔融星球等待着被开发，我们必须找到它们、提高效率。

星系就是我们的设计图板，是时候开始行动了。
introductions.en:
Our fleet has never been bound to a single world, but the riches of this system warranted a more permanent installation. The Arc Furnace was our answer, a feat of engineering that converts the fury of a molten world into material output. Upgrading it to full capacity will be essential to fuel our expansion.

But there is only so much one system can offer. Elsewhere in the galaxy, other molten worlds may yet await exploitation, and efficiency demands we find them.

The galaxy is our drafting board, and it is time to get to work.

description.zh: 一道巨大的时空裂隙高悬于该文明母星的穹顶。在研究这一现象近千年后，最近的星舰科技进展使其终于可以靠近他，并且发掘潜藏其中的秘密。
description.en: A massive rift in space and time looms near this civilization's homeworld. After studying the phenomenon for millennia, recent advances in starship technology will allow them to finally reach out and discover what secrets it might hold.

introductions.zh:
自我们有记忆起，大裂隙就在[GetHomeWorldName]的天空中高悬着。传说我们的遥远过去与这道天界之痕还有我们首都附近的天降之坑相互纠缠。

我们祖祖辈辈都将这个撞击坑视为圣地，却对其知之甚少。然而，最近的地震活动却让坑下的一处异常现象重见天日。我们正在着手向其核心钻探。至于在坑里到底会有什么发现，人们莫衷一是。

这难道只是一个发生在我们超空间引擎科技取得进展时的普通巧合吗？就在我们直抵天界时，我们的注意力被重新拉回了地面上。也许在这颗星球的地下潜藏着的是对于我们前往星间旅行的启迪，也许它可以让我们做好应对裂隙另一端的事物的准备。
introductions.en:
For as long as we can remember, the Great Rift has loomed in the skies above [GetHomeWorldName]. Legends propose that our past is intimately entwined with this mysterious celestial scar and an ancient impact site near our capital.

For generations, the site was revered, but little understood. However, recent seismic activity has uncovered subsurface anomalies in the crater. Preparations are already underway to drill into its core. Opinions remain divided on what we may uncover there.

Is it simple coincidence that this has occurred at the advent of Hyperdrive technology? Just as we reach for the heavens, our attention is pulled back to the ground. Perhaps what lies beneath the surface of this world is meant to aid us on our journey to the stars. Perhaps it can prepare us for whatever lies beyond the Rift.

introductions.zh:
穷尽我们数据库所能追溯的最早时间，大裂隙就早已高悬于[GetHomeWorldName]的上空。我们的内部时钟于该裂隙天体的频率相同步，而最早的记录则记录了一处位于我们首都附近的远古撞击坑。

无数次迭代以来，该撞击坑都被保留下来，但却对其几乎没有任何了解。然而，最近的地震活动却让坑下的一处异常现象重见天日。我们正在准备向其核心钻探。

这难道只是一个发生在我们超空间引擎科技取得进展时的普通巧合吗？就在我们直抵天界时，我们的注意力被重新拉回了地面上。也许在这颗星球的地下潜藏着的是对于我们前往星间旅行的启迪，也许它可以让我们做好应对裂隙另一端的事物的准备。
introductions.en:
For as long as our databanks reach back, the Great Rift has loomed in the skies above [GetHomeWorldName]. Our internal clocks are synced with the frequency of the celestial scar and our earliest records describe an ancient impact site near our capital.

For many iterations, the site was left alone, but little understood. However, recent seismic activity has uncovered subsurface anomalies in the crater. Preparations are already underway to drill into its core.

Is it simple coincidence that this has occurred at the advent of Hyperdrive technology? Just as we reach for the heavens, our attention is pulled back to the ground. Perhaps what lies beneath the surface of this world is meant to aid us on our journey to the stars. Perhaps it can prepare us for whatever lies beyond the Rift.

introductions.zh:
自我们有记忆起，大裂隙就在虚空中高悬着——它就这样一直横亘在我们旅途的地平线之上，我们无法解释，却又无比熟悉。传说我们的遥远过去与这道天界之痕，以及深藏于我们方舟船体内部的某个远古撞击点有着千丝万缕的关系。

多年以来，这个地方俨然成为圣地，却鲜有人能真正了解。然而，最近方舟核心系统出现的波动，将人们的注意力引向了撞击点附近那些长期封闭的舱室。我们正准备突破这些舱室。至于我们会在那里发现什么，大家众说纷纭。

系统波动恰好发生在超光速引擎技术问世之际，这会是单纯的巧合吗？正当我们要伸手触碰星辰之时，注意力却被拉回了自己的飞船。或许，封存在我们方舟内部的东西，本就注定要助我们一臂之力。或许，它能让我们做好准备，去面对大裂隙另一侧可能存在的任何事物。
introductions.en:
For as long as we can remember, the Great Rift has hung before us in the void - a constant presence on the horizon of our journey, as familiar as it is unexplained. Legends propose that our past is intimately entwined with this mysterious celestial scar, and with an ancient impact buried deep within the hull of our arkship.

For generations, the site was revered, but little understood. However, recent fluctuations in the arkship's core systems have drawn attention to long-sealed chambers near the impact point. Preparations are already underway to breach them. Opinions remain divided on what we may uncover there.

Is it simple coincidence that this has occurred at the advent of Hyperdrive technology? Just as we reach for the stars, our attention is pulled back to our own vessel. Perhaps what lies sealed within our arkship is meant to aid us on our journey. Perhaps it can prepare us for whatever lies beyond the Rift.

description.zh: 在暴力和苦难中，这个文明在一位领袖的领导下走向了统一。通过压制较弱的派系来巩固权力，他们现在成为了科学和技术进步的坚定倡导者。在这之后，是一段不稳定的和平的时期。但和平终究是一种短暂的状态。
description.en: Amidst violence and hardship, this civilization was unified by a single leader. Consolidating power through the repression of weaker factions, they have now become a fierce advocate for science and technological advancement. In the aftermath, an uneasy peace has descended. But peace rarely lasts.

description.zh: 在政治动荡中，没有了光耀者的指引，人们必须在星系中开辟自己的道路。
description.en: Amidst political turmoil, and without the Luminary's guidance, the people must make their own way in the galaxy.

Consolidating power through the repression of weaker factions, they have now become a fierce advocate for science and technological advancement. In the aftermath, an uneasy peace has descended. But peace rarely lasts.

description.zh:
§R-警告：具有挑战性的起源§!
这个文明曾被一个异星帝国造访过，这个帝国强行启蒙了他们，之后奴役了他们。如今他们击退了入侵者，但那些入侵者有朝一日还会回来吗？
description.en:
§RWARNING: Challenging Origin§!
This civilization has been visited by an alien empire who forcibly enlightened and enslaved them. They have repelled their invaders, but will they return?

introductions.zh:
我们曾经做过一个交易。

当来自外部星辰的访客显露身形时，他们向我们提供了一份公平的合同：技术启蒙，分期偿还。在一代人的时间里，我们的行星被转变成为了一个所谓的“先进文明”。

然后我们才了解到小字条款：为了偿还我们的“债务”，他们坚持要我们为他们劳作，而且是无限期的。我们的领袖对此反对，但这些外来者马上翻脸动用了暴力。我们奋起反抗。

我们赢了，但是赢得十分艰难，并且为此付出了惨烈得代价。现在，我们的科学家终于从过去我们摧毁的飞船上，通过逆向工程攻破了超光速旅行的秘密。宇宙很大，但迟早我们肯定会再次遇到我们的“恩人”。而实际上，我们也迫不及待，摩拳擦掌。

现在是时候血债血偿了。
introductions.en:
We had a deal.

When the visitors from the stars revealed themselves, they offered us a fair contract: technological enlightment, to be repaid in installments. Within a generation, our planet was transformed into a so-called 'advanced civilization.'

Then we read the fine print: to repay our 'debt', they insisted we work for them, on an indefinite term. When our leaders protested, the outsiders turned violent. We fought back.

We won, though barely, and only after suffering sizeable losses. Now, our scientists have finally reverse-engineered the secrets of FTL travel from the ships we destroyed. It's a big galaxy out there, but sooner or later we're sure to meet our 'benefactors' again. In fact, we're looking forward to it.

It's time to get some payback.

我们曾经做过一个交易。

当来自外部星辰的访客显露身形时，他们向我们提供了一份公平的合同：技术启蒙，分期偿还。在一代人的时间里，我们的行星被转变成为了一个所谓的“先进文明”。

然后我们才了解到小字条款：为了偿还我们的“债务”，他们坚持要我们为他们劳作，而且是无限期的。我们的领袖对此反对，但这些外来者马上翻脸动用了暴力。我们奋起反抗。

我们赢了，但是赢得十分艰难，并且为此付出了惨烈得代价。现在，我们的科学家终于从过去我们摧毁的飞船上，通过逆向工程攻破了超光速旅行的秘密。宇宙很大，但迟早我们肯定会再次遇到我们的“恩人”。而实际上，我们也迫不及待，摩拳擦掌。

现在是时候血债血偿了。
introductions.en:
We had a deal.

When the visitors from the stars revealed themselves, they offered us a fair contract: technological enlightment, to be repaid in installments. Within a generation, our planet was transformed into a so-called 'advanced civilization.'

Then we read the fine print: to repay our 'debt', they insisted we work for them, on an indefinite term. When our leaders protested, the outsiders turned violent. We fought back.

We won, though barely, and only after suffering sizeable losses. Now, our scientists have finally reverse-engineered the secrets of FTL travel from the ships we destroyed. It's a big galaxy out there, but sooner or later we're sure to meet our 'benefactors' again. In fact, we're looking forward to it.

It's time to get some payback.

description.zh:
§R-警告：具有挑战性的起源§!

这个文明始于一艘奴隶船上的发起的兵变，现在由多种多样的前超光速物种组成。
description.en:
§RWARNING: Challenging Origin§!

This civilization began as a mutiny aboard a slaver vessel, and is made up of a diverse group of pre-FTL species.

introductions.zh:
终于自由了！

有些人生来便负着枷锁。还有的负债累累，然后被作为契约奴隶任人买卖。但前主人的科技并不能保护他们周全。我们密谋反叛。在一场短暂但血腥的斗争中，我们杀死了俘虏我们的人，也重创了他们的运奴船。我们不得已紧急迫降到[Root.Capital.GetName]的表面上。

尽管我们来自五湖四海和不同的物种，但我们找到了共同的目标。假以时日，这艘运奴船受损的系统就能修好，藏在其中的大量秘密-包括我们曾经母星的位置-也能被揭晓。

我们已挣脱枷锁。现在就开始劳动吧。
introductions.en:
Free at last!

Some were born into bondage. Others, crippled by debt, found themselves sold as indentured labor. But the technology of our former masters was not enough to save them. In secret, we planned our mutiny. During the brief, bloody struggle, our captors were killed, and their slave ship critically damaged. An emergency landing left us stranded on the surface of [Root.Capital.GetName].

Though we are made up of species from many different worlds, we have found common cause. In time, the damaged systems of the slaver vessel will be repaired, and its bounty of secrets - including the location of our former home worlds - will be revealed.

Our shackles are broken. Now the work begins.

introductions.zh:
终于自由*了！

有些人生来便负着枷锁。还有的负债累累，然后被作为契约奴隶任人买卖。然而我们都畅想着，能够过上轻松而富足的生活。我们密谋反叛。在一场短暂但血腥的斗争中，我们杀死了俘虏我们的人，也重创了他们的运奴船。我们不得已紧急迫降到[Root.Capital.GetName]的表面上。

尽管我们来自五湖四海和不同的物种，但在您的领导下我们找到了共同的目标。我们的前主人也许非常残酷，但他们懂得经营生活。我们应该像他们一样坚定地追求我们的利益。假以时日，这艘运奴船受损的系统就能修好，藏在其中的大量秘密-包括我们曾经母星的位置-也能被揭晓。我们已挣脱枷锁。是时候成立公司了。

*法律告示：
此处使用“自由”一词并不代表本公司将提供任何折扣或进行任何影响[Root.GetName]股东收益的活动。如对此或其他术语有任何疑问，或是希望退出[Root.Capital.GetName]上的持续存在，请在[Root.Capital.GetName]的行政办公楼联系我们的法律或安保专家，以获取他们的快速处理。
introductions.en:
Free* at last!

Some were born into bondage. Others, crippled by debt, found themselves sold as indentured labor. All of us dreamed of something more, a life of ease and abundance. In secret, we planned our mutiny. During the brief, bloody struggle, our captors were killed, and their slave ship critically damaged. An emergency landing left us stranded on the surface of [Root.Capital.GetName].

Though we are made up of species from many different worlds, under your directorship we have found common cause. Our former masters may have been cruel, but they understood the business of life. Like them, we must be steadfast in our pursuit of profit. In time, the damaged systems of the slaver vessel will be repaired, and its bounty of secrets - including the location of our former home worlds - will be revealed. Our shackles are broken. Now is the time to incorporate.

*Legal Notice:
The use of the word 'free' is non-binding and does not oblige the Corporation to provide any discount or volunteer any action that could affect the profit margins of [Root.GetName] shareholders. If you have any questions regarding this or other terms, or should you wish to opt out of continued existence on [Root.Capital.GetName], please contact our legal or security professionals in the Administrative Offices on [Root.Capital.GetName] for immediate resolution.

description.zh: 一个世纪以前，在帝国的母星系，其中的一颗行星被一颗古怪的小行星摧毁了。一些人认为这是某个外星物种的恶意攻击。其他人则把这些担忧当作纯粹的妄想症。两类人之间的关系变得愈发紧张，最后无可奈何之下，帝国将一个新近完成地形改造的星球给予这些恐宇派。
description.en: A century ago, one of the planets in this empire's home system was destroyed by a freak asteroid. Some believed this was a malicious attack by an alien species. Others brushed off these concerns as mere paranoia. The tension between the two groups grew so great that a newly-terraformed planet was granted to the fearmongers.

introductions.zh:
一个世纪以前，被我们称为“大分裂者”的行星发生了爆炸。这便是我们 分裂的开端。

起先我们对这颗星球的毁灭不太在意，充其量只是一件怪事罢了，但[GetHomeWorldName]的一些人认为这其实是一场针对我们物种的有预谋的袭击。这些人认定是我们的无线电信号被远处的某些外星人发现了，他们便以这种足以毁灭行星的武器回应我们。这些反对者敦促我们做好应对这些外星人再次来袭甚至摧毁我们的准备。更多的人则认为他们的忧虑是杞人忧天。

两个派别之间的政治割裂日益加深。蔓延全球的内乱最终促成了一项协议，为这些反对者们寻找到一个环境改造候选星球，这样他们就可以在其中隐居，不受我们的干涉。

随着超光速引擎的出现，一个新的紧张局势出现了：我们渴望拥抱宇宙，但我们的邻居却旗帜鲜明地反对。
introductions.en:
A century ago, the planet we now call "The Divider" exploded. This was the beginning of our dissociation.

At first we brushed off the destruction as a freak occurrence, but there were some on [GetHomeWorldName] who believed it was a premeditated attack on our species. This faction hypothesized that our radio transmissions had been detected by some distant alien race, a race that replied with a planet-cracking projectile. These dissenters urged us to prepare for the day when the aliens would return to finish us off. Many dismissed their concerns as paranoia.

The political division between the two camps continued to grow. Planet-wide civil unrest culminated in the creation of a treaty that granted the dissidents a terraforming candidate, a planet upon which they would be free to reside in seclusion without any interference from us.

With the advent of the Hyperdrive, a new source of tension has arisen: while we are eager to greet the galaxy, our neighbors stand resolutely in opposition.

introductions.zh:
一个世纪以前，被我们称为“大分裂者”的行星发生了爆炸。这便是我们 互相疏远的开端。

在那场事故以后，忧心忡忡的经理们向董事会发来请求，希望能关停所有现存的行星间无线电通讯设施，取消太空探索计划。他们相信大分裂者一定是某种外来的力量在尝试摧毁[GetHomeWorldName]。这项请求当然被否决了。

这些经理们将董事会的决议称为“史诗级误判”，并激活了公民协议中的一项副条款，他们有权公开斥责董事会。为了安抚股东和增强消费者信心，决定向持异议的经理提供一份新合同。作为放弃与 [GetName] 有关的任何权利的交换，他们将获得一颗环境改造候选星球，并且保证他们的财政自主。

随着超光速引擎的出现，一个新的紧张局势出现了：我们渴望拥抱宇宙，但我们的邻居却旗帜鲜明地反对。
introductions.en:
A century ago, the planet we now call "The Divider" exploded. This was the beginning of our estrangement.

After the incident, worried managers sent requests to our Board of Directors to shut down existing extra-planetary radio infrastructure and cancel our space exploration programs. They believed the creation of The Divider was caused by an external agent attempting to destroy [GetHomeWorldName]. This request was denied.

Calling the Board's decision a "monumental lapse of judgment", these managers activated a sub-clause in their citizenship contracts that granted them the right to publicly rebuke the Board. In an effort to placate share-holders and to bolster consumer confidence, the decision was made to offer the dissenting managers a new contract. In exchange for giving up any rights pertaining to [GetName], they would be provided with a terraforming candidate, and a guarantee of fiscal independence.

With the advent of the Hyperdrive, a new source of tension has arisen: while we are eager to greet the galaxy, our neighbors stand resolutely in opposition.

description.zh: 这个文明不择手段地增强自己的有机体，无论风险，无论成本。毕竟，与其在沉默中消亡，不如光鲜亮丽地燃烧殆尽。
description.en: This civilization uses any and all means of organic enhancement, no matter the risk, no matter the cost. After all, it is better to burn out brightly than fade away into obscurity.

introductions.zh:
自然是个不温不火的发明家，而进化则如同冰川流动一般迟缓。为了发展繁荣我们需要身强力健、敏捷如飞并且脑力超群，而且我们等不了一百万年，只争朝夕。自然选择吝啬于赐予我们礼物，我们只能自己动手。

于是我们的文明的原则便如此建立起来了：我们要无限制地强化我们的身躯。这些强化把我们的星球统一了起来，并且将带领我们走向更遥远的未来。

基因工程赐予我们超强大脑、无尽膂力和无上勇气，我们定能在群星间繁荣昌盛……这也是设计完美的生物才能拥有的特权。
introductions.en:
Nature is a tepid inventor. Evolution is a glacial process. To prosper we require strength, speed and brain power - now, not in a million years. Natural selection is miserly with its gifts and so we must improve ourselves.

Thus our civilization is built on the principle of unrestrained enhancement of our physical bodies. These enhancements have allowed us to unite our world under one banner, and now they will lead us even further.

With genetically crafted brains, brawn, and bravery, we shall prosper among the stars... As only a perfectly designed species can.

虚空不会给弱者划出保留地。这些强化已让我们足以应对它的苛刻要求，并将我们的人民团结在同一面旗帜之下，带领我们走向更遥远的未来。

基因工程赐予我们超强大脑、无尽膂力和无上勇气，我们定能在群星间繁荣昌盛……这也是设计完美的生物才能拥有的特权。
introductions.en:
Nature is a tepid inventor. Evolution is a glacial process. To prosper we require strength, speed and brain power - now, not in a million years. Natural selection is miserly with its gifts and so we must improve ourselves.

The void makes no allowances for weakness. These enhancements have hardened us against its demands and united our people under one banner. Now they will lead us even further.

With genetically crafted brains, brawn, and bravery, we shall prosper among the stars... As only a perfectly designed species can.

description.zh: 几个世纪前，这个物种的母星被一位毒性神祗造访。接踵而至的生态灾难几乎摧毁了这个星球，但是幸存者们怀着对毒圣的崇敬之情，草草地统一了起来。他们创立了一个骑士教团来搜寻毒圣，尽管后来很多事情变了，但是这份试炼依旧保留了下来。
description.en: Centuries ago, this species' homeworld was visited by a Toxic Entity. The ecological catastrophe that followed ruined half the world, but allowed an early unification of the survivors in their reverence for the Toxic God. An Order of Knights has been created to search for the Toxic God, and although many things have changed, the quest continues.

introductions.zh:
很久以前，我们的行星四分五裂。沐猴而冠的所谓国王们互相征伐，无数的人口为之白白牺牲。但第一位至高王的到来改变了一切。天赐与他的领导能力铸就了一个无与伦比的王国。

至高王虔诚无比。他向一切一切不信者宣战，但异端仍野火烧不尽。直到一天，毒圣降临到了我们的星球，至高王的祈祷得到了回应。尽管祂的到来只是短短一瞬，但祂剧毒的影响力瞬间毒化了所有不信者之地。所有幸存者纷纷效忠至高王。我们的星球第一次获得了统一。

毒圣很快又离我们而去，但至高王却决定找到祂，为此建立了一个骑士团。数个世纪以来，这些英勇的灵魂们孜孜不倦地寻找，但一无所获。毒圣已经离开我们的星球太久了。试炼的下一个章节将会在星际间谱写。利用强大的遗珍，骑士团建立了我们帝国第一个空间站。坚固无比的主城将会是他们飞向茫茫星海的跳板。
introductions.en:
Long ago, our planet was divided. Petty kings squabbled constantly, and our population bled for their vain ambitions. But with the coming of the first High King, all of this changed. Their inspired leadership forged a kingdom without equal.

Above all else, the High King was pious. War was waged against any who denied their God, but still the heretics persisted. The King's prayers were answered when the Toxic God visited our world. Though its time among us was brief, its baneful influence poisoned the lands of the unbelievers. Any who survived pledged fealty to the High King. For the first time, our world was unified.

The Toxic God soon left us, but the King, determined to find it, founded an order of knights. For centuries, these valiant souls searched tirelessly, but to no avail. The Toxic God had long since departed from our world. The next chapter of the Quest would be written in the stars. With the use of powerful relics, it was the Order that built our Empire's first orbital station. A mighty Keep, it would become the springboard from which they plunged ever deeper into the cosmos.
