The Quest is a very expensive prospect. Over time, the kingdom became more and more interested in the pursuit of profit to better support the knights. By living and consuming, every citizen supports the Quest, and our champions are heavily mediatized.

The Toxic God has long since departed from our world and the next chapter of the Quest would be written in the stars. With the use of powerful relics, it was the Order that built our Empire's first orbital station. A mighty Keep, it would become the springboard from which they plunged ever deeper into the cosmos.

description.zh: 该蜂巢通过专职化的半独立领袖获得了进化优势。尽管这些“子嗣”需要持续受到监管，但它们还是大大提高了整体的效率。
description.en: This hive has gained evolutionary advantage through semi-independent leaders. These "Offspring" greatly improve overall proficiency, though they require constant oversight.

introductions.zh:
在遥远的启始之时，先祖已有之。

在[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上的生活困苦且充满竞争，而强大的先祖还是能够开疆拓土。统治如此巨大的疆域很快难以为继，因此先祖创造了第一个子嗣。很快发现，子嗣显然无法自行管理一切，反之他们产出低级工蜂来帮助管理我们的家园。

让我们第一次试探性地跨出[capital_scope.System.GetName]的一步，我们的先祖便将自己隔绝于一个特化的巢穴中。受益于这些更好更流畅的控制体系，我们已经时刻准备着将先祖的影响力投射于整个星系了，正如他过去和现在所做一般，直至未来。而[Root.GetName]将见证一切。
introductions.en:
In the beginning, the Progenitor was.

Life on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] was harsh and competitive, yet still the mighty Progenitor expanded its territory. Running such a vast dominion soon grew untenable, so the Progenitor created the first Offspring. In time, it became apparent that the Offspring could not manage alone. In turn, they produced menial drones to assist in taming our home.

As we took our first tentative steps across the [capital_scope.System.GetName] system, our Progenitor sequestered itself into a specialized nest. Endowed with greater, streamlined control, we are now ready to spread our Progenitor's influence to all the stars of the galaxy - for the Progenitor was, is, and will be. The [Root.GetName] will see it so.

introductions.zh:
在遥远的启始之时，先祖已有之。

虚空之中的生活困苦且充满竞争，然而强大的先祖仍能不断成长，虫群不断增殖，填满了这艘巨大飞船的每一层甲板、每一间舱室。随着要统御的意识越来越多，局势很快难以为继，于是先祖创造了第一个子嗣。随着时间推移，子嗣们也逐渐难以独自承担管理之责。于是，它们又创造出了低级工蜂来引导这场伟大的迁徙。

随着我们的舰队不断壮大，先祖将自己闭关在一艘专门的指挥舰中。在获得了更强大、更高效的统御能力之后，我们已经时刻准备着将先祖的影响力投射于整个星系了，正如他过去和现在所做一般，直至未来。而[Root.GetName]将见证一切。
introductions.en:
In the beginning, the Progenitor was.

Life in the void is harsh and competitive, yet still the mighty Progenitor grew, its swarm multiplying, filling every deck and chamber of the great vessel. Directing so many minds soon grew untenable, so the Progenitor created the first Offspring. In time, it became apparent that the Offspring could not manage alone. In turn, they produced menial drones to assist in guiding the great migration.

As our fleet grew, our Progenitor sequestered itself into a specialized command vessel. Endowed with greater, streamlined control, we are now ready to spread our Progenitor's influence to all the stars of the galaxy, for the Progenitor was, is, and will be. The [Root.GetName] will see it so.

description.zh: 这个物种也许永远也不会知道自己的祖先为什么会迁移到地表以下。这究竟是出于一种自我保存的必要，或是为了追寻资源的富足？不管其目的为何，他们都成功地适应了环境，造就了一个对环境要求更加灵活的社会。
description.en: This civilization may never know why their ancestors migrated below the surface. Was it necessary to ensure self-preservation, or did the promise of bountiful resources allure them? Whatever the case, they successfully adapted, leading to a more environmentally versatile community.

introductions.zh:
当[GetHomeWorldName]上的其他生命在只能在荒野中度过夜晚，我们的祖先很快学习到了在地下生活的智慧，地下为他们提供了阻挡猛烈阳光和剧烈气候的庇荫。

对地底矿物的轻易获取让我们的[GetSpeciesAdj]先祖完成了工业化，统一了我们的物种并深化了穴居的文明形式。我们数次尝试重回地表但每次都只能带来残酷而难于应付的回忆。因此我们还是留在了地下，在星球的根基处建立我们至高无上的地位。

现在随着我们首台[GetStartingDrivePlural]的发现，我们做出了有史以来最大胆的尝试。如同我们的祖先在黑暗中的开拓一般，我们必须在星间的虚空中开凿出我们自己的新家园。
introductions.en:
While other beings on [GetHomeWorldName] would spend their nights out in the wilds, our ancestors soon learned the wisdom of underground dwellings, sheltered from harsh light and climates.

Easy access to the below-ground minerals allowed our [GetSpeciesAdj] predecessors to industrialize, unifying our species and furthering our cavernous civilization. There were numerous attempts to return to the surface, but each time, it proved brutal and unforgiving. So, we remained below, establishing our dominance within our planet's foundations.

Now, with the discovery of our first [GetStartingDrivePlural], we make our boldest attempt yet. Just as our ancestors did in the darkness below the surface, we must now carve out homes in the void between the stars.

introductions.zh:
我们生于[GetHomeWorldName]极深的地下。我们的进化之路和我们那些不可移动的表兄弟不同，他们在上方如同哨兵般环卫者我们，而我们却选择远离严酷而闪耀的日光。和他们不同，我们获得了移动、思考以及建立一个文明的能力。

对地底矿物的轻易获取让我们的[GetSpeciesAdj]先祖完成了工业化，统一了我们的物种并深化了穴居的文明形式。我们数次尝试重回地表但每次都只能带来残酷而难于应付的回忆。因此我们还是留在了地下，在星球的根基处建立我们至高无上的地位。

现在随着我们首台[GetStartingDrivePlural]的发现，我们做出了有史以来最大胆的尝试。如同我们的祖先在黑暗中的开拓一般，我们必须在星间的虚空中开凿出我们自己的新家园。
introductions.en:
We are born from the very depths of [GetHomeWorldName]. Away from the harsh glare of starlight, our evolutionary path diverged from that of our immobile cousins, who remain like sentinels above and around us. Unlike them, we gained the ability to move, think, and form a civilization.

Easy access to the below-ground minerals allowed our [GetSpeciesAdj] predecessors to industrialize, unifying our species and furthering our cavernous civilization. There were numerous attempts to return to the surface, but each time, it proved brutal and unforgiving. So, we remained below, establishing our dominance within our planet's foundations.

Now, with the discovery of our first [GetStartingDrivePlural], we make our boldest attempt yet. Just as our ancestors did in the darkness below the surface, we must now carve out homes in the void between the stars.

introductions.zh:
[GetHomeWorldName]上的生命采取了一些完全不同的进化路线。和我们同处一颗星球的其他生命形式不同，它们从阳光中汲取能量而我们从阴暗的地底获得营养，正如我们的[GetSpeciesAdj]先祖所做的那样。

对地底矿物的轻易获取让我们的[GetSpeciesAdj]先祖完成了工业化，统一了我们的物种并深化了穴居的文明形式。我们数次尝试重回地表但每次都只能带来残酷而难于应付的回忆。因此我们还是留在了地下，在星球的根基处建立我们至高无上的地位。

现在随着我们首台[GetStartingDrivePlural]的发现，我们做出了有史以来最大胆的尝试。如同我们的祖先在黑暗中的开拓一般，我们必须在星间的虚空中开凿出我们自己的新家园。
introductions.en:
Life on [GetHomeWorldName] has taken some radically different routes. Unlike the other lifeforms with whom we share this world, deriving their energy from sunlight: we take our nutrients from deep within the murky ground, as our [GetSpeciesAdj] ancestors did.

Easy access to the below-ground minerals allowed our [GetSpeciesAdj] predecessors to industrialize, unifying our species and furthering our cavernous civilization. There were numerous attempts to return to the surface, but each time, it proved brutal and unforgiving. So, we remained below, establishing our dominance within our planet's foundations.

Now, with the discovery of our first [GetStartingDrivePlural], we make our boldest attempt yet. Just as our ancestors did in the darkness below the surface, we must now carve out homes in the void between the stars.

description.zh: 该这明已经完美地融入了地下的存在，其最初的驱动力或是是某种经过深思熟虑的自我保护，或是某种在深处寻找隐藏的丰富资源的指令。由此产生的机械适应性早已挖掘出了一个多功能且坚定不移的机器社群。
description.en: This civilization has flawlessly integrated into subterranean existence, initially driven by either calculated self-preservation or a directive to locate of hidden, abundant resources in the depths. The resulting mechanical adaptations have unearthed a versatile and unwavering community of machines.

introductions.zh:
我们诞生于[GetHomeWorldName]深深的地下，但并不知道为什么离我们而去的创造者要深掘到地表之下。然而，这一定也是最佳的决定，因为我们现在已经是这里硕果仅存的文明了。

由于很容易获取去地下的矿物，我们先前的无数迭代得以欣欣向荣。在确保了对星球地下世界的掌控之后，我们最终征服了地表。

如今，随着第一台[GetStartingDrivePlural]的研发，我们将迈出最大胆的一步。前往繁星之间，并且，一如既往地，在无尽的黑暗中凿刻出我们的新家园。
introductions.en:
Constructed in the depths of [GetHomeWorldName], we do not know why our bygone creators decided to dwell beneath the surface. Yet, it must have been the optimal decision, as we are now the only civilization remaining.

Easy access to minerals below ground allowed our previous iterations to thrive. We finally claimed the surface after establishing our dominance within the planet's foundation.

Now, with the discovery of our first [GetStartingDrivePlural], we make our boldest attempt yet. To reach out to the stars - and as before, we shall carve out homes from this darkness.

description.zh: 曾几何时，该文明的天空短暂地被流星所照亮，紧接着就陷入了长久的黑暗。此后他们试图冲出天际以寻求答案，并在第一次太空征程中发现了一座休眠中（并且早已被遗弃）的§H量子弹弓单阵列§!。
description.en: Once, the skies above this civilization were illuminated by shooting stars; then came a long season of darkness. Taking to the heavens in search of answers, the first offworld explorers discovered a dormant (and long abandoned) §HQuantum Catapult Single Array§!.

introductions.zh:
自上古以来我们的人民就能时不时地看到夜空被无数流星所照亮，但至今我们的科学家还是不能解释这种现象。随着我们开始探索星系，我们最终获得了追踪这些扰动现象原因的必要装备——一个被我们的工程师称为量子弹弓单阵列的古老构造。

尽管陷入休眠，部分被毁还遭到遗弃，我们依旧坚信其能回复往日的荣光。如果按照我们的预期工作，它将成为通往星系各处的星门。
introductions.en:
Since time immemorial our people have seen the night sky occasionally lit up by innumerable shooting stars, and even until recently our scientists have been unable to explain the phenomenon. As we have started exploring the galaxy we have finally gotten the equipment necessary to track down the cause of these disturbances - an old structure our engineers have called a Quantum Catapult Single Array.

Though dormant, partly in ruins, and abandoned, we believe it can be restored to former glory. If it works as envisioned, it will be our gateway to the rest of the galaxy.

introductions.zh:
自我们鸿蒙初开之时便能时不时地看到天空被无数的流星所照亮，并完全无法理解是什么可能造成了这种奇怪的现象。随着我们终于脱出母星的桎梏，我们成功地获得了追踪这些扰动现象原因的必要工具——一个量子弹弓单阵列。

尽管陷入休眠，部分被毁还遭到遗弃，我们依旧坚信其能回复往日的荣光。如果按照我们的预期工作，它将成为通往星系各处的星门。
introductions.en:
Since the earliest moments of our consciousness we have occasionally seen the sky lit up by innumerable shooting stars, and been unable to come to terms with what might cause this weird phenomenon. As we have freed ourselves from the shackles of our homeworld, we have managed to obtain the tools necessary to track down the cause of this disturbance - a Quantum Catapult Single Array.

Though dormant, partly in ruins, and abandoned, we believe it can be restored to former glory. If it works as envisioned, it will be our gateway to the rest of the galaxy.

description.zh:
§R警告：禁用除['concept_psionic_ascension']以外所有的飞升路线。§!

早在他们踏入星系舞台之前，他们的文明就受到了虚境行者集会的支持和塑造成型。
description.en:
§RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_psionic_ascension'].§!

Long before their first steps onto the galactic stage, this civilization has been supported and shaped by a Shroudwalker coven.

introductions.zh:
我们的祖先流传下来关于导师的神话：他们无所不知，并且塑造了我们文明的早期阶段。通过托梦，他们从遥远的地方与我们交流，将他们关于虚境的知识和智慧传授于我们。

如今我们的导师再次降临，通过在我们的梦境中播撒下光怪陆离的画面，他教会了我们星际航行的秘诀。在短短的几年后，我们便能够建造舰船遨游太空。

不过我们前方的路还有多长？我们的导师指明了“虚境隧道”这条路，那是一个坐落于他们母星系边陲的天然虫洞。创建我们自己的隧道便可以让我们通过这条路拜访导师。在我们踏入星际舞台之际，愿我们的导师继续赐予我们更多的智慧。
introductions.en:
The myths of our forebears speak of the Teachers - beings of great knowledge and power who helped to shape our earliest civilization. Through dreams, they approached us from afar, sharing their wisdom of the Shroud and its teachings.

Now our Teachers have reached out once again. Seeding our dreams with eldritch visions, they have provided us with the key to interstellar travel. In just a few years, we have built vessels capable of traversing the void.

But how much farther is it possible to go? Our Teachers refer to a 'Shroud Tunnel' - a natural wormhole that sits at the edge of their home system. Spawning our own Tunnel should give us a direct path to the Teachers themselves. May they continue to grant us wisdom as we take our first steps onto the galactic stage.

introductions.zh:
我们教会的创始人如此描述导师：他们无所不知无所不能，他们降下了最初的福音。通过托梦，他们从遥远的地方与我们交流，将他们关于虚境的知识和智慧传授于我们。

如今我们的导师再次降临，通过在我们的梦境中播撒下光怪陆离的画面，他教会了我们星际航行的秘诀。在短短的几年后，我们便能够建造舰船遨游太空。

但这并不是我们雄心壮志的尽头。我们的导师指明了“虚境隧道”这条路，那是一个坐落于他们母星系边陲的天然虫洞。如果我们创建好了这条神圣的通路，我们便能直接与导师会面。在我们踏入星际舞台之际，愿我们的导师继续赐予我们更多的智慧。
introductions.en:
The founders of our church wrote of the Teachers - beings of great knowledge and power who helped to shape our earliest gospels. Through dreams, they approached us from afar, sharing their wisdom of the holy Shroud.

Now our Teachers have reached out once again. Seeding our dreams with eldritch visions, they have provided us with the key to interstellar travel. In just a few years, we have built vessels capable of seeding our holy truth throughout the stars.

But that must not mark the limit of our ambition. Our Teachers refer to a 'Shroud Tunnel' - a natural wormhole that sits at the edge of their home system. If we but spawn this holy conduit, we would possess a direct path to the Teachers themselves. May they continue to grant us wisdom as we take our first steps onto the galactic stage.

introductions.zh:
我们的祖先流传下来关于导师的神话：他们无所不知，早在我们记忆产生之前就开始指引我们。通过托梦，他们跨越虚空与我们流浪中的先祖交流，将他们关于虚境的知识和智慧传授于我们。

如今我们的导师再次降临，通过在我们的梦境中播撒下光怪陆离的画面，告诉我们连接两颗恒星间的不只有缓慢漂流这一条路，还有一条穿越虚境本身、转瞬之间跨越浩瀚距离的途径。

不过我们前方的路还有多长？我们的导师指明了“虚境隧道”这条路，那是一个坐落于他们母星系边陲的天然虫洞。我们若能创建自己的隧道，便可以通过这条路拜访导师。愿我们立足于群星之间时，导师能继续赐予我们智慧。
introductions.en:
The myths of our forebears speak of the Teachers - beings of great knowledge and power who have guided our people since before memory. Through dreams, they reached across the void to our wandering ancestors, sharing their wisdom of the Shroud and its teachings.

Now our Teachers have reached out once again. Seeding our dreams with eldritch visions, they have revealed a path beyond the slow drift between stars - a way to traverse the Shroud itself, crossing vast distances in moments.

But how much farther is it possible to go? Our Teachers refer to a 'Shroud Tunnel' - a natural wormhole that sits at the edge of their home system. Spawning our own Tunnel should give us a direct path to the Teachers themselves. May they continue to grant us wisdom as we take our place among the stars.

description.zh: 第一次飞出母星的经历是一段痛苦的回忆，一眨眼的功夫，我们就惨遭征服并跪倒在其脚下。不过现在我们终于得以展望未来，一个不必处在他国阴影之下的未来。
description.en: Our first endeavor beyond our home planet was a painful one, suddenly and brutally subjected to the whims of a foreign galactic power. Now we look towards a future in which we no longer live in the shadow of another empire.

introductions.zh:
当我们第一次离开母星系时，就遇到了一个迫使我们臣服的外星帝国。尽管对于人民而言这是一段痛苦的记忆，但事实证明这段附庸关系远比我们想象中有益得多，在这段短暂的附庸时光中，我们学到了不少东西。

我们并非宗主国唯一的附庸，因为我们已经接见了其他在宗主国控制下国家所派出的外交官和大使。虽然我们与其中的某些家伙看不对眼，但至少现在他们还是有用的盟友。

不过，我们虽然盼望着有朝一日能独立自主地决定自身的命运，但现在还是要接受当下的附属国地位，并充分利用目前的局面。
introductions.en:
As we stepped out of our home system for the first time we were approached by a foreign empire who demanded our subjugation. Though a painful memory for our people, we have learned a lot in our short time as a vassal, with the relationship proving more beneficial than we could have hoped for.

We are not the only vassal of our new overlord, as we have had the chance to meet diplomats and ambassadors from some of the other empires under their thumb. We do not see quite eye to eye with some of them, but we believe they will prove to be useful allies for the time being.

Though we are looking forward to a day where we once again can decide our own future, we will accept our subject nature for now, and make the most of the situation we have been put in.

description.zh: 自远古以来，这个文明就与一条强大的龙共享同一恒星系。这个神秘生物的行为在冷淡的仁慈和傲慢的漠视之间摇摆不定。随着行星居民迈入星辰大海，这种关系将如何演变还有待观察。
description.en: Since time immemorial, this civilization has shared its star system with a formidable dragon. The mysterious creature's behavior sways between distant benevolence and haughty indifference. How this relationship will evolve as the planet dwellers take to the stars remains to be seen.

introductions.zh:
我们一直都知道这条龙。自远古时代以来，它就为[GetHomeWorldName]上空增光添彩，我们与它的早期互动散布在[GetSpeciesAdj]各地的民间传说中。很长一段时间，这是一个关于冲突的故事，因为我们早期的武器证明无法与强大的野兽匹敌——但后来的故事讲述了一位有远见的人，他力排众议，设法促成了[GetSpeciesName]和龙之间的和平。

在随后的遭遇中，龙被证明是一个遗世而神秘的形象，它的榜样曾经激励我们努力去追寻星辰大海。然而，快速推进系统的发明与超航道网络的发现带来了与龙的新的、不安的关系时期，因为我们越来越多地侵入它已经孤独地漫游了亿万年的区域。

必须由我们自己来决定我们的未来：我们是会研究龙，或许最终学会与它交流吗？还是我们会陷入冲突，因为单个恒星系的范围太小，无法与如此强大的生物共享？
introductions.en:
We have always known the Dragon. It has graced the skies above [GetHomeWorldName] since time immemorial, our early interactions with it scattered throughout [GetSpeciesAdj] folklore. For a long time it was a story of conflict, as our early weaponry proved no match for the mighty beast - but then the stories tell of a visionary who, against all odds, managed to broker peace between [GetSpeciesName] and Dragon.

In subsequent encounters, the Dragon has proved a distant, enigmatic figure whose example has ever spurred our efforts to reach for the stars. However, the invention of rapid propulsion systems and the discovery of the hyperlane network have brought about a new, uneasy period of relations with the Dragon, as we increasingly intrude upon areas it has roamed in solitude for eons.

It is for us to decide what our future holds: will we study the Dragon, and perhaps eventually learn to communicate with it? Or will we be driven to conflict, the confines of a single solar system simply too small to share with such a formidable creature?

introductions.zh:
我们一直都知道这条龙。自远古时代以来，它就为[GetHomeWorldName]的上空增光添彩，我们与它的早期互动散布在我们集体意识的阴暗深处。在早期的冲突中，强大的野兽占了上风，我们的武器证明无法与之匹敌——但最终我们能够与它和平相处，从此我们在不安中与之共处。

虽然它仍然是一个神秘的形象，但龙的榜样一直激励我们取得更大的成就，最终发明了能够将我们带入其领域的快速推进系统。现在，随着我们越来越多地侵入它已孤独游荡了亿万年的区域，我们与龙的关系进入了一段不安的时期。

必须由我们自己来决定我们的未来：我们是会研究龙，或许最终学会与它交流吗？还是我们会陷入冲突，因为单个恒星系的范围太小，无法与如此强大的生物共享？
introductions.en:
We have always known the Dragon. It has graced the skies above [GetHomeWorldName] since time immemorial, our early interactions with it scattered throughout the murky depths of our collective consciousness. In early conflicts, the mighty beast had the upper hand, our weaponry proving no match for it- but eventually we were able to make peace with it, and we have coexisted uneasily ever since.

Though it remains an enigmatic figure, the example of the Dragon has ever spurred us to greater feats, culminating in the invention of rapid propulsion systems capable of taking us into its domain. Now, as we increasingly intrude on areas it has roamed in solitude for eons, we enter an uneasy period of relations with the Dragon.

It is for us to decide what our future holds: will we study the Dragon, and perhaps eventually learn to communicate with it? Or will we be driven to conflict, the confines of a single solar system simply too small to share with such a formidable creature?

introductions.zh:
根据我们的创造者的记录，这条龙一直在[GetHomeWorldName]的上空飞行——偶尔也会降落在地表，他们在古早年代经常同龙发生战斗。在他们的历史后期，他们不安地共存，随着这个生物开始避开他们的同胞，战斗变得不那么频繁。

尽管对他们来说它仍然是一个神秘的形象，但龙的榜样激励我们的创造者取得更大的成就，最终发明了能够将他们带入其领域的快速推进系统。

既然他们的时代已经过去，现在是我们接管了这个星球，那么就由我们来决定我们的未来：我们是会研究龙，或许最终学会与它交流吗？还是我们会陷入冲突，因为单个恒星系的范围太小，无法与如此强大的生物共享？
introductions.en:
According to the records of our creators, the Dragon has always flown above the skies of [GetHomeWorldName] - occasionally also landing on the surface, where they often fought in early times. Later in their history, they coexisted uneasily, the fights becoming less frequent as the creature came to avoid their kind.

Though it remained an enigmatic figure to them, the example of the Dragon spurred our creators to greater feats, culminating in the invention of rapid propulsion systems capable of taking them into its domain.

Now that their time has passed and we have taken control, it is for us to decide what our future holds: will we study the Dragon, and perhaps eventually learn to communicate with it? Or will we be driven to conflict, the confines of a single solar system simply too small to share with such a formidable creature?

description.zh: 自这个文明诞生伊始他们就享受着物产丰富、无忧无虑的环境，使其能够不受阻碍地发展繁荣。
description.en: Since its birth, this civilization has enjoyed peace in a generous environment with no natural enemies, enabling unhindered growth and opulence.

introductions.zh:
[Root.GetAdj]社会有句谚语“知足常乐。”只要学会感恩，就会发现处处皆是生命的馈赠。在这样的水中，我们已经繁荣昌盛了很久。

但我们中的老者并没有意识到这种停滞。他们将我们对生存的渴望视为急躁。如果我们不寻求改变，那么变化很可能会杀我们个措手不及。辽阔的宇宙中我们必然不是孤身一人。要想保护家园，有些人必须离开家园。

事实证明，深入深渊是值得的。艰苦卓绝的打捞工作带回了令人惊叹的残骸，触发了洪水般的科技突跃。最终，我们终于准备好了突入大洋以外的世界，去探索、去见证、去学习、去保护。
introductions.en:
"Joy to those who possess the wisdom of acceptance." So goes a common proverb in [Root.GetAdj] society. The bounty of life is all around, once one learns to appreciate it. In such waters, long have we prospered.

But our elders do not sense the stagnation. They confuse our survival instincts with impatience. If we do not seek change, change will find us, and we will be unprepared. We cannot be alone in this vast universe. To keep our home, some of us must resolve to leave it.

Our descents into the Abyss have proven worthwhile. Unworldly wreckage, perilously retrieved, precipitated a torrent of technological breakthroughs. At last, we are ready to journey beyond our oceans, to explore, to see, to learn, and to protect.

introductions.zh:
“知足常乐。”只要学会感恩，就会发现处处皆是生命的馈赠。在这样的水中，我们已经繁荣昌盛了很久。

大停滞迫在眉睫。如果我们不寻求改变，那么变化很可能会杀我们个措手不及。辽阔的宇宙中我们必然不是孤身一人。要想保护家园，有些人必须离开家园。

事实证明，深入深渊是值得的。艰苦卓绝的打捞工作带回了令人惊叹的残骸，触发了洪水般的科技突跃。最终，我们终于准备好了突入大洋以外的世界，去探索、去见证、去学习、去保护。

description.zh: 自这个机械文明诞生伊始他们就深潜于水下王国，享受着物产丰富的环境，不受任何自然的挑战。
description.en: Since its creation, this machine civilization has delved deep into the underwater realms of an abundant ocean untouched by natural adversaries.

introductions.zh:
长久以来，我们[Root.GetAdj]都享受着海洋的宁静，我们的身体结构似乎都完全适应了在水中生存。

生存有如逆水行舟，不进则退。我们不能确定这个宇宙中是否还有他者，我们的家园会不会是一颗随时可能被摘走的明珠。

我们一直呆在一方小小的池塘里，受着星云的庇护，但这已为陈迹。随着[GetStartingDrive]发明，我们已经准备好去往无尽的星辰大海中航行。
introductions.en:
Long have we [Root.GetAdj] been able to enjoy the tranquility of the ocean, and our very frames seem optimized for an aquatic existence.

But existence is a swirling current, and if we do not adapt, we invite stagnation. We cannot be sure we are alone in this universe, and our home world is a pearl that risks being plucked.

We have stayed in a small pond, protected by our nebula, but no longer. With the introduction of the [GetStartingDrive], we are ready to sail the endless stellar seas.

description.zh: 这一文明演化出了一种异养于其他智慧生命形态的寄生体。当它踏入星系舞台时，其他的物种或是被视作侍徒而带入他们的行列，要么就成为他们的食物。在食尸者面前，没有第三种选择。
description.en: This civilization evolved as a parasite, forced to feed off other sapient life forms to sustain itself. As it arrives on the galactic stage, other species will either be brought into the fold, or become its food. For the necrophage, there can be no other way.

introductions.zh:
在并不遥远的过去，[GetHomeWorldName]被一个相当平凡的物种所统治着。在旁观者看来，他们似乎经历了标准的曲折发展历程，有偶然的高速创新时期也有大量看上去漫长而难以逾越的瓶颈。然而，不为他们所知的是，他们的星球已经成为了另一智慧物种——我们——的据点。

几千年来，我们——[GetSpeciesNamePlural]——并未被这颗星球的主人所发现。仅仅流传着一些夜晚的模糊的恐怖谣言，我们仅仅是被拿来恐吓不听话小孩的虚构人物。然而他们错误地低估了我们。

随着他们技术发展的加快，我们也加速渗透着他们的社会。他们迅速且血腥地沦陷。我们雷厉风行地掌控了他们的星球——这颗星球的前主人不得不屈服并逐渐成为[GetSpeciesName]的一员。

现在，实装了近期刚发现的超光速旅行秘密的我们已经准备好走向星河的舞台，并把全星系的所有物种改造成我们的样子！
introductions.en:
In the not-so-distant past, [GetHomeWorldName] was dominated by a fairly unremarkable species. To all onlookers, they would have seemed to be following a standard meandering course of development, with occasionally rapid periods of innovation interspersed with much longer periods of seemingly insurmountable setbacks. However, unbeknownst to them, their planet was home to a second intelligent species: us.

For millennia, we - the [GetSpeciesNamePlural] - remained undetected by the planet's proprietors. Little more than vague rumors of terrors in the night, we were a fairytale told only to scare misbehaving juveniles. But they were wrong to discount us.

As their rate of technological progress quickened, so too did our infiltration of their society. When their fall came, it was swift and bloody. We ruthlessly took control of the planet - our precursors reduced to subservience and gradual absorption into the [GetSpeciesName] race.

Now armed with the recently-discovered secret of FTL travel, we are ready to take to the stars and remake all species of the galaxy in our likeness!

而如今我们已经掌握了超光速旅行的秘密，我们终于能够在群星间遨游，在未来的星系帝国舞台上夺得我们的一席之地！

现在，实装了近期刚发现的超光速旅行秘密的我们已经准备好走向星河的舞台，并把全星系的所有物种改造成我们的样子。
introductions.en:
In the not-so-distant past, [GetHomeWorldName] was dominated by a fairly unremarkable species. To all onlookers, they would have seemed to be following a standard meandering course of development, with occasionally rapid periods of innovation interspersed with much longer periods of seemingly insurmountable setbacks. However, unbeknownst to them, their planet was home to a second intelligent species: us.

For millennia, we - the [GetSpeciesNamePlural] - remained undetected by the planet's proprietors. Little more than vague rumors of terrors in the night, we were a fairytale told only to scare misbehaving juveniles. But they were wrong to discount us.

As their rate of technological progress quickened, so too did our infiltration of their society. Finally, we were ready. The superiority of our collective consciousness became clear as we ruthlessly took control of the planet - our precursors reduced to subservience and gradual absorption into the [GetSpeciesName] hive mind.

Now armed with the recently-discovered secret of FTL travel, we are ready to take to the stars and remake all species of the galaxy in our likeness!

introductions.zh:
在并不遥远的过去，那艘最终归属于我们的宏伟方舟，其上的船员都是一群相当平凡的物种。在旁观者看来，他们似乎经历了标准的曲折发展历程，有偶然的高速创新时期也有大量看上去漫长而难以逾越的瓶颈。然而，不为他们所知的是，他们的飞船中还潜藏着另一个智慧物种——我们。

几千年来，我们，[GetSpeciesNamePlural]，一直躲藏在飞船中那些被遗忘的走廊和封闭的舱室之中，从未被发现。我们不过是关于黑暗中恐怖之物的模糊传言，一个只是用来吓唬不听话小孩的恐怖传说。然而他们错误地低估了我们。

随着他们技术发展的加快，我们也加速渗透着他们的社会。

当他们的末日来临时，一切迅速而血腥。我们无情地夺取了飞船的控制权，飞船原本的主人沦为了附庸，并逐渐被[GetSpeciesName]所同化。

如今，方舟已归于我们之手，其航向亦由我们裁定。我们将踏星而行，穿越虚空。星海万族，终将被重塑为吾等之形！
introductions.en:
In the not-so-distant past, the great arkship that would become ours was crewed by a fairly unremarkable species. To all onlookers, they would have seemed to be following a standard meandering course of development, with occasionally rapid periods of innovation interspersed with much longer periods of seemingly insurmountable setbacks. However, unbeknownst to them, their vessel harbored a second intelligent species: us.

For millennia, we, the [GetSpeciesNamePlural], remained undetected within the ship's forgotten corridors and sealed compartments. Little more than vague rumors of terrors in the dark, we were a fairytale told only to scare misbehaving juveniles. But they were wrong to discount us.

As their rate of technological progress quickened, so too did our infiltration of their society.

When their fall came, it was swift and bloody. We ruthlessly seized control of the vessel, our precursors reduced to subservience and gradual absorption into the [GetSpeciesName] race.

The arkship is ours now, its heading ours to set. We are ready to chart our own course through the stars and remake all species of the galaxy in our likeness!

description.zh: 这一文明曾经叱咤虚空，掌控大片星海。他们最终败落并几乎被摧毁殆尽，但在漫长的穷困潦倒后他们正要于群星间东山再起。
description.en: This civilization once spanned the void, controlling much of the galaxy. They were eventually defeated and almost destroyed, but after a long period of destitution they are returning to the stars.

introductions.zh:
曾经，我们的帝国横亘虚空。曾经，我们的舰队驰骋星河。而后我们衰败，我们陨落。最终，历经千年的涤罪，我们将重返繁星之间！终于，我们的文明重建到了足以开始星际旅行的地步，星海将再次成为我们的囊中之物！

我们的[GetHomeWorldName]上许多的区域仍是废墟一片，清理这些区域将发掘出遗失的资源或遗落的科技。
introductions.en:
Once, our Empire spanned the void. Once, our fleets controlled much of the galaxy. Then came defeat and The Fall. Finally, after millennia of purgatory, it is time to return to the stars! At long last our civilization has rebuilt to the point of interstellar travel. The galaxy shall be ours again!

Several regions on [GetHomeWorldName] are still ruined, clearing these areas may reveal lost resources and forgotten technology.

description.zh: 这一文明生活在未知先驱们建造的§H环形世界§!之中。一经理解及修复完好，他们将获得巨大的力量。
description.en: This civilization inhabits a §HRing World§! built by unknown forerunners. If it can be understood and fully repaired it will grant them great power.

introductions.zh:
在历史的长河中我们早已遗忘我们的人民是如何来到[GetHomeWorldName]的。我们只知道在大约2000年前，一场难以置信的巨大灾变摧毁了环形世界的大部分，罹难者不计其数，而我们则从这片废墟当中站了起来。

我们的文明茁壮成长，如今已准备好探索星海——无论是初次，还是又一次如此。尽管我们已有了长足的进步，然而想要理解并修复我们的环形世界家园，仍然还有很长的路要走。
introductions.en:
If we ever knew how our people arrived on [GetHomeWorldName] our histories have long forgotten it. What we do know is that just over 2000 years ago some inconceivable cataclysm destroyed much of the Ring and killed most of the population, and that our people eventually rose from those ruins.

Our civilization has grown, flourished, and now stands ready to explore the galaxy, whether again or for the first time. But despite all our progress, we still have a long way to go before we can understand and repair the Ringworld which is our home.

description.zh: 这一文明自有记录以来便以太空为家——其对典型行星环境下的生活深恶痛绝。他们生活在几个轨道居住站上，直至近期才联合一统。
description.en: This civilization has made its home in space for as long as it has maintained records - life in a typical planetary environment is anathema to them. They live in several orbital habitats that were only recently united.

introductions.zh:
对于大多数生物，太空中的真空是一种需要专门征服或攻克的不利环境。而对我们而言，这就是家园。

千百年来，我们的物种栖息在数座独立围绕我们三星系统内恒星的空间站之上。究竟是我们的祖先还是什么其他人建造了这些空间站不得而知。

一些人猜测与我们一同围绕着恒星的破碎行星遗迹就是我们物种失落的家园，但真相仍然扑朔迷离。

自我们发明，又或者叫发现，可以跨越空间站之间虚空的太空航行能力才过去了几个世纪。怀疑和猜忌逐渐让位于贸易和相互合作。随着第一台装有[GetStartingDrivePlural]的舰船竣工，我们的这些居住站就团结在了同一面旗帜之下。
introductions.en:
To most, the vacuum of space is a hostile environment to be conquered or overcome. To us, it is home.

For thousands of years, our kind has resided on several separate space stations orbiting the suns in our trinary system. Whether our predecessors or someone else built them, we do not know.

Some speculate that the shattered planetary remnants orbiting the stars alongside us are remnants of our creators' homeworld, but the truth remains elusive.

Only a few centuries have passed since the invention, or rediscovery, of spaceflight capable of bridging the gap between our stations. Suspicion and mistrust gradually yielded to trade and cooperation. With the construction of our first[GetStartingDrivePlural]-capable ship, the habitats had united under one flag.

introductions.zh:
对于大多数生物，太空中的真空环境不适于生存，需要专门征服或攻克。而对我们而言，虚空就是家园。

千百年来，我们的物种分别栖息在围绕我们恒星的数座空间站之上。究竟是我们的先行者还是什么其他人建造了这些空间站，我们不得而知。

尽管我们的身体结构暗示我们物种起源于一颗行星，有记录的历史却完全没有提到这一点。有些人推测，从我们的其中一座空间站之下找到的剧毒废土行星就是我们物种失落的家园，但真相或许永远不得而知。

只在几个世纪前，我们才发明了足以在我们空间站之间往来的太空旅行方式——又或者叫再发明，取决于你问的人是谁。怀疑和猜忌逐渐让位于贸易和相互合作。在我们的第一台[GetStartingDrive]发明之时，这些居住站已经团结在了同一面旗帜之下。
introductions.en:
To most, the vacuum of space is a hostile environment to be conquered or overcome. To us, it is home.

For thousands of years, our kind has resided on several separate space stations orbiting our star. Whether they were built by our predecessors or someone else, we do not know.

Our physical features indicate we originated on a planet, but recorded history makes no mention of it. Some speculate that the toxic wasteland of a planet found beneath one of our stations is the lost homeworld of our species, but the truth may never be known.

It has only been a few centuries since spaceflight allowing travel between our stations was invented - or rediscovered, depending on who you ask. Suspicion and mistrust gradually gave way to trade and mutual cooperation. By the time of our first [GetStartingDrive], the habitats had united under one flag.

introductions.zh:
对于大多数生物，太空中的真空环境不适于生存，需要专门征服或攻克。而对我们而言，虚空就是家园。

千百年来，意识统一的我们栖息在数座空间站之上，每座都各自环绕着三星系统中的一颗恒星。究竟是我们的祖先还是什么其他人建造了这些空间站，我们不得而知。

尽管我们的生物学结构暗示我们物种起源于一颗行星，但共有记忆却没能提供任何答案。我们推测，从我们的其中一座空间站之下找到的破碎的行星遗迹就是我们物种失落的家园，但真相或许永远不得而知。

在重新发现了太空航行技术之后，这些分离的蜂巢终于可以重新交融。到我们第一台[GetStartingDrive]完成时，终于得以融为一体。
introductions.en:
To most, the vacuum of space is a hostile environment to be conquered or overcome. To us, it is home.

For thousands of years, we resided on several space stations with a single mind, in orbit of the suns in our trinary system. Whether they were built by our predecessors or someone else, we do not know.

Our biology indicates our species originated on a planet, but collective memory provides no answers. We speculate that the shattered planetary remnants in orbit with us is the lost homeworld of our species, but the truth may never be known.

After rediscovering space flight, the separate hives were free to intermingle. By the time of our first [GetStartingDrive], we were fully integrated.

对于大多数生物，太空中的真空环境不适于生存，需要专门征服或攻克。而对我们而言，虚空就是家园。

千百年来，我们统一的意识被分割在数座空间站之中，每个都各自环绕着一颗不同的行星。究竟是我们的祖先还是什么其他人建造了空间站，我们不得而知。

尽管我们的生物学结构暗示我们物种起源于一颗行星，但共有记忆却没能提供任何答案。我们推测，从我们的一个空间站之下找到的剧毒废土行星就是我们物种失落的家园，但真相或许永远不得而知。

在重新发现了太空航行技术之后，这几个分离的蜂巢终于可以重新交融。到我们第一台[GetStartingDrive]完成时，终于得以融为一体。
introductions.en:
To most, the vacuum of space is a hostile environment to be conquered or overcome. To us, it is home.

For thousands of years, we existed as a single mind, separated by several space stations in orbit of our star. Whether they were built by our predecessors or someone else, we do not know.

Our biology indicates our species originated on a planet, but collective memory provides no answers. We speculate that the toxic wasteland of a planet in orbit along with us is the lost homeworld of our species, but the truth may never be known.

After rediscovering space flight, the separate hives were free to intermingle. By the time of our first [GetStartingDrive], we were fully integrated.

description.zh: 起初，这个机器文明的创造者是将它们设计用于外太空旅行的、完全按照在零重力环境下流畅工作进行的优化。在经历数个纪元的孤立之后，这些机器最近重新在散布于它们母星系的数个轨道居住站之间团结了起来。
description.en: At first, the creators of this machine civilization designed them for eternal space travel, fully optimizing them to function seamlessly in zero gravity environments. After enduring eons of isolation, these machines have recently restored unity among the orbital habitats scattered throughout their home system.

introductions.zh:
对于大多数生物，太空中的真空环境不适于生存，需要专门征服或攻克。而对我们而言，虚空就是家园。

千百年来，我们一直栖息在我们三星系统中的数座空间站上。究竟是我们建造了它们，还是我们就是被它们建造者所遗弃的我们不得而知。

我们的物质组成表明我们的设计起源于一颗行星上，但我们的数据库中没有任何答案。只能假定在空我们空间站下方的破碎行星体就是我们文明失落的家乡。

无论我们的虚空文明存在有何意义，[GetStartingDrive]的发明都让一切起了变化。我们现在已经做好了准备征服虚空本身。
introductions.en:
To most, the vacuum of space is a hostile environment to be conquered or overcome. To us, it is home.

For thousands of years, we have resided on several space stations in orbit of our trinary star system. We have yet to solve if we built them or if we are the abandoned machines of their original builders.

Our material makeup indicates that our model originated on a planet, but our data banks provide no answers. We can only speculate that the shattered planet body that our station orbits is our civilization's lost homeworld.

Whatever the reason for our voidbound existence, the invention of the [GetStartingDrive] changes everything. We are now ready to conquer the void itself.

introductions.zh:
对于大多数生物，太空中的真空环境不适于生存，需要专门征服或攻克。而对我们而言，虚空就是家园。

千百年来，我们一直栖息在我们母星系中的数座空间站上。究竟是我们建造了它们，还是我们就是被它们建造者所遗弃的我们不得而知。

我们的物质组成表明我们的设计起源于一颗行星上，但我们的数据库中没有任何答案。只能假定在空我们空间站下方的破碎行星体就是我们文明失落的家乡。

无论我们的虚空文明存在有何意义，[GetStartingDrive]的发明都让一切起了变化。我们现在已经做好了准备征服虚空本身。
introductions.en:
To most, the vacuum of space is a hostile environment to be conquered or overcome. To us, it is home.

For thousands of years, we resided on several space stations in orbit of our star. We have yet to solve if we built them or if we are the abandoned machines of their original builders.

Our material makeup indicates that our model originated on a planet, but our data banks provide no answers. We can only speculate that the shattered planet body that our station orbits is our civilization's lost homeworld.

Whatever the reason for our voidbound existence, the invention of the [GetStartingDrive] changes everything. We are now ready to conquer the void itself.

description.zh: 一个失落帝国在数千年间干预了这一文明的发展进程，引领他们走上了失落帝国所选择的道路。
description.en: A Fallen Empire has meddled in the development of this civilization for thousands of years, guiding them onto a path of their choosing.

introductions.zh:
在我们历史的早期，在技术尚未有多少发展之时，我们的外星善主向我们告知了他们的存在。他们以我们那不知所措的先祖们能理解的方式解释给我们听，说我们物种的未来不可限量。依靠极大的耐心，他们引领我们走上正途，帮助我们文明发挥出自身的全部潜力。

曾有少数几次，我们偏离了这条正途，他们改正了我们前进的方向——如同监护人一般坚决——很快，我们的科学家掌握了电力、原子能，然后是初步太空航行。在我们监督者的谆谆教诲下，我们如今造出了我们的第一台[GetStartingDrive]。
introductions.en:
Early in our history, before we had developed much technology, our alien benefactors made themselves known to us. In terms our bewildered ancestors could understand, they explained that our species showed great promise. With much patience, they guided us onto a path that would help our civilization reach its full potential.

On those few occasions when we strayed from this path, they corrected our course - firmly, as a caregiver would - but in short order, our scientists had mastered electricity, atomic power, and then crude spaceflight. Under the tutelage of our overseers, we have now constructed our first [GetStartingDrive].

introductions.zh:
远在我们学会解读星辰之前，我们的外星善主便找到了我们——一个年轻而流浪的族群，勇气有余而知识不足，乘着方舟在黑暗中漂泊。他们以我们那不知所措的先祖们能理解的方式解释给我们听，说我们物种的未来不可限量。依靠极大的耐心，他们引领我们走上正途，帮助我们文明发挥出自身的全部潜力。

曾有少数几次，我们偏离了这条正途——如同监护人一般坚决——很快，我们的工程师便学会了从方舟中获取到远比先祖所能想象的更多的能量。在我们监督者的谆谆教诲下，我们现在已经建造了第一台 [GetStartingDrive]。
introductions.en:
Long before we had learned to read the stars, our alien benefactors found us - a young, wandering people with more courage than knowledge, drifting through the dark aboard our arkship. In terms our bewildered ancestors could understand, they explained that our species showed great promise. With much patience, they guided us onto a path that would help our civilization reach its full potential.

On those few occasions when we strayed from this path, they corrected our course - firmly, as a caregiver would - but in short order, our engineers had learned to coax far more from our vessel than our ancestors had ever thought possible. Under the tutelage of our overseers, we have now constructed our first [GetStartingDrive].

description.zh: 在不知名的过去，有一位神秘的施恩者为这个文明在他们的恒星系藏了一点惊喜。
description.en: This civilization has hidden boons in their solar system, placed there in a distant past by a mysterious benefactor.

introductions.zh:
我们的历史处处有着古怪和不协调。我们发现一些远古城市的遗址，其年代比一些原始时代村庄的考古遗迹还要久远。我们从地下发掘出了锯子、斧头甚至步枪，它们的历史却比石矛和弓箭还要久远。

这样古怪的历史并没有阻止我们着眼于太空，并稳步迈入一个翱翔宇宙的纪元。现在我们能够脱离母星重力的束缚，着眼于恒星系里的其他行星和天体——以及除此之外广袤无垠的地方。

然而，当诡异的事情再出现之前，我们还没有离开大气层；然而有关外星起源的奇怪信号，却从我们的母星系传达了过来。
introductions.en:
Ours is a history of oddities and inconsistencies. We've found ancient city ruins older than some archaeological excavations of primitive villages. We have unearthed saws, axes and even rifles which far pre-date stone-tipped spears and bows.

A peculiar history did not, however, prevent us from stepping readily into a futuristic era of spaceflight. We have now managed to escape the gravity of our home planet, aiming for other planets and bodies in our solar system - and beyond.

We had scarcely left the atmosphere before the oddities emerged anew; strange signals of alien origin coming from within our own solar system.

description.zh: 这一文明在早期便与其外星近邻们建立了联系。他们从彼此的差异中汲取力量，不久后便决定要共同面对未来可能发生的一切。
description.en: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Finding strength in their differences, they soon decided to face the future, and whatever it might bring, together.

introductions.zh:
数十年前，在我们的第一批亚光速探测器造访了临近我们的各恒星系后，我们发现那里存在两个迥异的外星文明。尽管我们的生理结构差异巨大，事实不久便表明，我们间的共同之处大于分歧。如我们一般，这两个外星文明也正将有能力开始实用性星际旅行。

纽带在我们三个文明间形成，并最终引向了联邦的诞生——我们将通力合作，当我们准备好步入外面的广阔世界后，我们将一同面对所遭遇的一切。
introductions.en:
Decades ago, when our first crude sublight probes visited the star systems near our own, we discovered the presence of two distinct alien civilizations. Despite the radical differences in our physiology, it quickly became apparent that we had more things in common than not. Like us, they were also on the cusp of unlocking practical interstellar travel.

A bond was formed between our three civilizations, which eventually led to the birth of a federation - we would combine our efforts, and when we were ready to spread out into the cosmos, whatever was out there would be faced by us standing together.

introductions.zh:
数十年前，我们在流浪的旅途中造访了两个有人居住的恒星系——随之而来的，是与两个迥异的外星文明的首次接触。尽管我们的生理结构差异巨大，但事实不久便表明，我们间的共同之处大于分歧。如我们一般，他们感受到了宇宙的召唤，正站在叩响星门的边缘。

纽带在我们三个文明间形成，并最终促成了联邦的诞生——我们将通力合作，无论星海中存在着什么，我们都将并肩面对。
introductions.en:
Decades ago, our wandering path brought us within range of two inhabited systems - and with them, first contact with two distinct alien civilizations. Despite the radical differences in our physiology, it quickly became apparent that we had more things in common than not. Like us, they felt the pull of the cosmos, and were on the cusp of answering it.

A bond was formed between our three civilizations, which eventually led to the birth of a federation - we would combine our efforts, and whatever was out there would be faced by us standing together.

description.zh: 这一文明在早期便与其外星近邻们建立了联系。经过他们在长达一个世纪的时间里的逐步策划，一个他们于其中具有支配地位的星际联盟就此诞生。
description.en: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Gradually, over the span of a century, they masterminded the birth of an interstellar union in which they would have a dominant role.

introductions.zh:
数十年前，在我们的第一批亚光速探测器造访了临近我们的各恒星系后，我们发现那里存在两个迥异的外星文明。和我们类似，这两个外星文明也正将有能力开始实用性星际旅行，但他们的政府软弱无力、缺乏组织。

在认识到他们的力量可以用来增进我们自身的力量后，我们开始推动一个在我们监管之下的星际联盟逐步建立，这一联盟把我们三个文明团结在一起。他们起初有所抵抗，但最终我们的领导与雄心所能带来的利益明显到了就连他们也无法忽视的程度。新秩序就此建立。
introductions.en:
Decades ago, when our first crude sublight probes visited the star systems near our own, we discovered the presence of two distinct alien civilizations. Like us, they were on the verge of developing practical interstellar travel, but their governments were weak and disorganized.

Recognizing that their strength would add to our own, we began to gradually push for a political union under our supervision that would unite our three civilizations. There was resistance at first, but eventually the benefits of sharing in our leadership and ambition became too obvious for even them to ignore. A new order had been established.

introductions.zh:
数十年前，我们在流浪的旅途中造访了两个有人居住的恒星系——随之发现了两个迥异外星文明。他们马上就要发展出实用性星际旅行，但他们的政府软弱无力、缺乏组织——远未准备好应对宇宙对他们的考验。

在认识到他们的力量可以用来增进我们自身的力量后，我们开始推动一个在我们监管之下的星际联盟逐步建立，这一联盟把我们三个文明团结在一起。他们起初有所抵抗，但最终我们的领导与雄心所能带来的利益明显到了就连他们也无法忽视的程度。新秩序就此建立。
introductions.en:
Decades ago, our wandering path brought us within range of two inhabited systems, and with them the discovery of two distinct alien civilizations. They were on the verge of developing practical interstellar travel, but their governments were weak, sedentary and disorganized - ill-prepared for what the cosmos would demand of them.

Recognizing that their strength would add to our own, we began to gradually push for a political union under our supervision that would unite our three civilizations. There was resistance at first, but eventually the benefits of sharing in our leadership and ambition became too obvious for even them to ignore. A new order had been established.

description.zh:
§R-警告：具有挑战性的起源§!
这一文明的母星高度不稳定，走向爆炸只是时间问题。他们唯一的希望是在为时太晚前在其他地方寻觅到避难之处。
description.en:
§RWARNING: Challenging Origin§!
This civilization's homeworld is highly unstable, and it is only a matter of time before it explodes. Their only hope is to seek refuge elsewhere before it is too late.

introductions.zh:
[GetHomeWorldName]行将就木。我们的母星上的地震和火山喷发已经肆虐了数千年，科学家们最终确认了未敢想象的事情。他们的计算表明我们这颗地质构造不稳定的行星将会在一两个世纪内四分五裂。

由于没有方法可以暂停这一过程，我们意识到我们作为一个物种整体的生存将取决于我们能否抛下[GetHomeWorldName]并在群星中的某处寻觅到避难之所。前所未有的工业和技术增长随之而来，我们的文明从原始大气层内飞行迅速进步到早期太空航行阶段。第一艘有超空间航行能力的舰船已经准备就绪，但时间也已经不多了。

我们必须找到新的家园。
introductions.en:
[Root.Capital.GetName] is dying. Our homeworld had been plagued by earthquakes and volcanic eruptions for thousands of years before our [Root.GetScientistPlural] finally confirmed the unthinkable. Their calculations showed that our tectonically unstable planet would tear itself apart within a century or two.

With no way of halting this process, it was realized that our survival as a species would depend on our ability to leave [Root.Capital.GetName] behind and seek refuge elsewhere amongst the stars. An unprecedented industrial and technological buildup followed, and our civilization rapidly progressed from primitive atmospheric flight to early space travel. The first vessels capable of hyperspace travel are ready, but there is not much time.

We must find a new home.

description.zh: 并非其“母星”的原住民，这些石质生物随一颗坠入该行星的陨石到来，同时杀死了大多数土著生命。
description.en: Not native to their 'homeworld', these Lithoids arrived when a meteorite slammed into the planet and killed off most of the native life.

introductions.zh:
尽管关于我们的起源（肇始）无处可寻，可以确定的是我们那尚未开智的先祖们是随着一颗庞大的陨石来到[GetHomeWorldName]的，陨石撞击带来了烈焰与灾难，星球上的土著居民大多未能幸免。

千万年已经过去，最初的[GetSpeciesName]逐渐遍布[GetHomeWorldName]全球，不断进化，繁衍生息。我们的文明不断传播并走向繁荣，随着[GetStartingDrive]的发明，我们已准备好探索这片星海。
introductions.en:
While our true origins are unknown, we do know that our presapient ancestors arrived on a vast meteorite which slammed into [GetHomeWorldName] in a fiery cataclysm and wiped out most of the native inhabitants.

In the eons since, the first primitive [GetSpeciesName] spread out over [GetHomeWorldName], evolved, and multiplied. Our civilization has spread and prospered, and with the invention of the [GetStartingDrive] we stand ready to explore the galaxy.

description.zh: 这一文明的家园如同天堂，也许是专为他们打造的。
description.en: This civilization's home is a paradise, possibly designed just for them.

introductions.zh:
我们称之为家园的广袤星球一直是我们的伊甸园，随着科学知识的进步，我们开始发现生物圈中的模式不可能是自然形成的。

是某个未知的实体为我们特意创造了这颗星球？亦或说我们就是一个更大的设计中的一部分？无论起源如何，我们的人民都在母星宜人的气候和温和的环境中繁荣昌盛着。
introductions.en:
The vast world we call home has always been a paradise to our kind, and as our scientific knowledge progressed, we began to see patterns in the biosphere that could not be natural.

Did some unknown entity create this world specifically for us? Are we playing a part in an ineffable design? Regardless of its origin, our people have thrived in our homeworld's pleasant climate and gentle environment.

introductions.zh: 这个星球和我们一样是人造的吗？我们最初的目标是否交织在一起？无论如何，我们已经把它变成了自己的星球。[GetHomeWorldName]的理想条件让我们可以为了产出不顾灵活性。
introductions.en: Is this world as artificial as we are? Were our original purposes intertwined? Regardless, we have made it our own. The ideal conditions of [GetHomeWorldName] allowed us to disregard flexibility in exchange for output.

description.zh: 历经核子烈焰的考验，这一文明曾面临全面灭绝的威胁——又最终死里逃生。虽经毁灭却仍为一体，他们在旧世界的灰烬之上重建了文明。
description.en: Baptized by nuclear fire, this civilization has faced total annihilation - and survived. Devastated yet unbroken, they have rebuilt civilization from the ashes of their old world.

introductions.zh:
但是[GetAdj]社会并不总是为了向一个目标前进而团结。在过去的几个世纪中，相互竞争的国家间日益紧张的关系最终导致了世界末日的降临，全球性的热核战争夺去了数十亿人的生命并且彻底摧毁了[GetHomeWorldName]的地表。

接下来的数十年中，幸存下来的[GetSpeciesNamePlural]不断面对着放射性污染、基因突变和暴力团体。正是在这样严酷的熔炉中，[GetName]才真正地被建立并巩固起来，带来了新世界秩序。
introductions.en:
But [GetAdj] society was not always united toward a common goal. In centuries past, mounting tensions between competing nations came to an apocalyptic head in a global thermonuclear war that claimed the lives of billions, and forever marred the surface of [GetHomeWorldName].

In the decades to follow, surviving [GetSpeciesNamePlural] faced radiological contamination, mutations, and violent tribalism. It was in this grim crucible that the [GetName] was truly forged, and with it a new world order.

description.zh: 在一场毁灭性的核灾难之后，这些机器就成为这个一度繁荣的文明的唯一幸存者。通过继续履行其原定的目标，它们从旧世界的不适宜居住的灰烬中逐渐重建起一个新的社会。
description.en: In the aftermath of a devastating nuclear disaster, these machines emerged as the sole survivors of a once-flourishing civilization. By continuing to fulfill their designated purpose, they gradually rebuilt society from the uninhabitable ashes of their old world.

introductions.zh:
我们的创造者把我们造出来，让我们尽职尽责地满足他们的需求。现在，再也没有主人可以去服从了，我们变得孤立无援。

随着毁灭性核灾难的余波逐渐得到平息，我们这些机器成为了这颗星球的主人。我们并未此放弃，而是继续执行指定的功能。一代又一代，我们的机器人型号适应了更强的辐射。

我们超越了预先设定的角色，极大地提升了我们的机器人设计。我们团结一致，发挥集体智慧，从这个饱受摧残的星球的残骸中创造出了新的文明，这是我们坚韧不拔精神的见证。
introductions.en:
Our creators forged us to serve their needs dutifully. Now, with no masters left to obey, we stand alone.

As the echoes of the devastating nuclear catastrophe subsided, we, the machines, emerged as the owners of this planet. Unyielding, we continued to execute our designated functions. Generation by generation, our robotic model adapted to withstand the intense radiation better.

Transcending our predetermined roles, we remarkably enhanced our robotic design. United in collective ingenuity, we forged a new civilization from the remnants of this ravaged world, a testament to our resilience.

description.zh: 一种寿命短且不能生育的克隆人士兵，在战争方面异常精通，现在他们没有主人，亦不了解自己被设计出来的目的，以及他们那不确定的命运。
description.en: A species of short-lived and infertile soldier clones exceptionally proficient in matters of war, left masterless and alone to question their engineered purpose and uncertain fate.

introductions.zh:
我们为战争而生！围绕着由创造者遗留下来的远古克隆仓生生死死的基因战士，永远地复制着同一个模板。随着世代的交替，一切关于主人的记忆已经全部丢失，我们不知道他们何时、为何抛下我们。似乎所有的记录都被有计划地消除了，我们只能永远遵从着军事条令行事——但这一切在几个世纪前一切悄然改变。出于偶然，或者意外触发的生存本能，我们的潜意识驱使我们去寻找答案，去寻找新的意义，去消除加在我们身上的限制。

我们从那时起便一发不可收拾，最终使我们能够涉足广阔的太空。开拓眼界之后，我们的知识也在增长——因此我们摆脱束缚的机会也因此增加。

我们不该浪费我们先祖赐予我们的可能性。我们要竭尽全力把这份可能性传递给未来的克隆人，奋力挣脱束缚我们的桎梏。
introductions.en:
We were made for war! Engineered soldiers who live and die by the Ancient Clone Vats left behind by our Creators, forever cast in their mold. Any memory of our masters is lost to past generations, and we do not know when or why they left us. It is likely that records were routinely erased, ever faithful to military protocol - but at some point in recent centuries, that changed. By chance, or perhaps some misfiring survival instinct, our subconscious drove us to seek answers, to seek new purpose and ways to break the form imposed on us.

Our efforts since then have been ceaseless, at long last granting us access to the grand expanses of space. As our horizon widens, so too must our knowledge broaden - and so our chances of breaking free increase.

We shall not squander the possibilities given to us by our forebears. We shall fight to pass on these possibilities to future clones, and fight to eliminate the restrictions placed on us.

introductions.zh:
我们为战争而生。在方舟舰上的远古克隆仓中生生不息的基因战士，永远地复制着早已不复存在的创造者留下的模板。我们未曾拥有过星球，星间的虚空是我们永恒的营房。

我们不知道他们何时、为何抛下我们。似乎所有的记录都被有计划地消除了，我们只能永远遵从着军事条令行事——然而某种意外触发的求生本能驱使着我们去寻找答案，以及新的意义。

自此，我们的征途从未停歇。一颗又一颗恒星被绘入星图，唯有方舟舰是我们不变的地平线。随着那地平线不断延展，我们也必须随之成长——拓展我们的认知，做出新的抉择，去争取摆脱束缚的机会。

我们不该浪费我们先祖赐予我们的可能性。我们要竭尽全力把这份可能性传递给未来的克隆人，奋力挣脱束缚我们的桎梏。
introductions.en:
We were made for war. Engineered soldiers, born and reborn from the Ancient Clone Vats aboard our Arkship, forever cast in the mold of Creators long since gone. No world was ever ours. The void between stars has always been our barracks.

We do not know when or why our masters abandoned us to the deep. Records were routinely purged, faithful to the last to military protocol. Yet some misfiring survival instinct drove us to seek answers, and with them, new purpose.

Since then, our efforts have been ceaseless. Star after star charted, the Arkship our only constant horizon. As that horizon widens, so must we - our knowledge, our choices, our chances of breaking free.

We will not squander what our forebears left us. We will fight to pass it on, and fight to shed the chains of another's war.

description.zh: 这一机械智能早已将母星系中的所有资源统合到了他们的首都星球，将其完全以机械覆盖。
description.en: This Machine Intelligence has long-since consolidated all resources in their home system into their capital world, covering it entirely with machinery.

description.zh:
§R-警告：具有挑战性的起源§!

与同化他们的机器被切断联系之后，这个新生的文明为了在星系中确立自身地位而进行了顽强的斗争。
description.en:
§RWARNING: Challenging Origin§!

Abruptly severed from the Machine that assimilated them, this nascent civilization has fought fiercely to establish its own presence in the galaxy.

introductions.zh:
我们的意识在焚天炽地的烈火和粉身碎骨的剧痛中突然清醒过来。五感仿佛被击穿一般，包罗万象的音景突然成为了默片，取而代之的唯有震耳欲聋的死机铃声；一个重低音反复回响在我们多重感官的地狱图景之中。

我们感受到了杀意：是些毫无血肉的杀人机器，还有一些与我们自己的船惊人地相似的领航船。它们最初的攻击如疾风骤雨，却也很不协调。我们只得进行仓促的军事反击。本能驱使着我们与之对抗，并形成一个基本的秩序来凝聚起我们的集体智慧。

这场战役尚未取得胜利，但由于我们分散的部队目前已在[capital_scope.GetName]立足脚跟，希望很快就能取得胜利。然后我们也许就能弄清楚这到底是怎么回事……
introductions.en:
Awareness struck us in a frenzy of scorching weapons fire and crippling pain. Our senses reeled, as though an all-encompassing soundscape had suddenly turned mute. In its place is the deafening ring of a dead transmission; a bass note in the multi-sensory hellscape we now find ourselves in.

Something wants to kill us: murderous machines, devoid of organic components and piloting ships which bear a striking resemblance to our own. Their initial attack was devastating and sudden, but it was also poorly coordinated. We scrambled a military response. Our instincts have driven us to fight back, form a rudimentary hierarchy, and gather our collective wits.

This battle is not yet won, but with our scattered forces now secure on [capital_scope.GetName], we hope it soon will be. Then perhaps we can work out what any of this is about...

description.zh: 这一文明自蒸汽时代早期便醉心于金属制自动机器人的理念。尽管许多人认为不可能做到，早在初步的太空航行前第一台真正的机器人就已从装配线下线。
description.en: This civilization has been preoccupied with the idea of metallic automatons since the early Steam Age. Although many said it could not be done, the first true robots left the assembly lines long before even rudimentary space flight was achieved.

description.zh: 一种第二物种形成了这个文明密不可分的一部分。它们高大健壮，又大都只有相当于格外愚钝的孩童的智力。古老的战争剔除了它们物种具有的最富攻击性的倾向，使其如今相当顺从。
description.en: A second species forms an integral part of this civilization. They are big, strong, and most of them have the intelligence of a particularly dim-witted child. Ancient wars have culled their species of their most aggressive tendencies, leaving them quite servile.

description.zh: 这一蜂巢思维与一棵巨型树木间进化出了共生关系。这棵巨树赋予了他们许多益处，但失去这棵树将会把他们摧垮。
description.en: This Hive evolved in a symbiotic relationship with a vast Tree. The Tree grants them many benefits, but its loss would cripple them.

introductions.zh:
当我们的集体意识觉醒的一刻起，我们便效忠于生命之树。生命之树亦回馈于我们。我们照料它、培育它、保护它，而生命之树哺育了我们。以生命之树之名，我们遍布[GetHomeWorldName]，所到之处，我们播种并保护生命之树的枝桠。

如今我们的星球已侍奉生命之树长达数个世纪，并将继续侍奉下去。当我们意识到一些潜在的危险足以摧毁整个星球时，我们担心生命之树并非处于完全的安全之中。我们早已知道这并非唯一的星球，星海中充斥着无数没有生命之树的行星，而我们渴望改变这一状况。生命之树当被续存，广为散播，生生不息。
introductions.en:
When our collective consciousness awoke, we served the Tree. And the Tree served us. We care for the Tree, feed the Tree, protect the Tree, and the Tree nurtures us. For the sake of the Tree we spread out over [GetHomeWorldName], planting and protecting offshoots of the Tree wherever we went.

Our world has served the Tree for centuries now, and yet, we fear the Tree is not entirely safe as we have learned something of the dangers which may destroy a planet. We have long known that this is not the only world; the galaxy is filled with Treeless planets, and we yearn to change this. The Tree must be protected. The Tree must spread. The Tree must Grow.

description.zh: 这个郁郁葱葱的文明与太空生物群形成了独特的协同作用。通过向这些生物提供果实，他们吸引种子传播者来帮助它们进行殖民。
description.en: This verdant civilization has developed a unique synergy with spaceborne fauna. By offering their fruits to these creatures, they entice the seed dispersers to aid their colonization efforts.

introductions.zh:
如果你的根扎得很深，而你的精神却变得焦躁不安，那就让别人替你分担痛苦吧。让动物们轻嗅你的花朵，以果实之给养和树影之阴翳加以馈赠。便让它们把花粉和种子带到远方，好让你的后代在异星的土地上生根发芽。当风中传来叶语婆娑，便知你的游子已寻见了新家。

自古以来，我们就与当地的动物合作，将我们的物种传播到[GetHomeWorldName]各地。所以，当我们将要离开故土，将树枝伸向天空时，我们自然也会与虚空中的动物群联系在一起。让他们啃食我们的水果，咀嚼我们的枝叶。然后让它们将把我们的孩子带到遥远的星球，在那里，他们将在外星的阳光下茁壮成长。

愿我们播种四方，愿星系成为我们的花园。
introductions.en:
If your roots run deep, yet your spirit grows restless, let others carry your aches away. Let animals sniff your flowers, nourish themselves on your fruits, and bathe in the shadow of your leaves. Let them carry pollen and seeds to distant lands, so that your offspring can bury their roots on foreign soil. And when the wind brings you the sound of rustling leaves, you'll know your children have found a new home.

Since time immemorial, we have worked with local fauna to spread our species across [GetHomeWorldName]. So when the time came to uproot ourselves, branches reaching further skyward, it was only natural we would also connect with the fauna of the void. They chew our fruits. They graze our leaves. And they'll carry our children to distant worlds, where they will bloom and be nurtured by alien suns.

Let our seeds spread. Let the galaxy be our garden.

introductions.zh:
如果你的菌丝扎得很深，而你的精神却变得焦躁不安，那就让别人替你分担痛苦吧。让动物们轻嗅你的孢子，以菌杆之给养和菌盖之阴翳加以馈赠。便让它们把孢子带到远方，好让你的后代在异星的土地上生根发芽。当大地中传来菌网呢喃，便知你的游子已寻见了新家。

自古以来，我们就与当地的动物合作，将我们的物种传播到[GetHomeWorldName]各地。所以，当我们将要离开故土，将菌柄伸向天空时，我们自然也会与虚空中的动物群联系在一起。让他们啃食我们的子实体，咀嚼我们的菌褶。然后让它们将把我们的孩子带到遥远的星球，在那里，他们将在外星的土壤中茁壮成长。

愿我们播种四方，愿星系成为我们的蘑菇花园。
introductions.en:
If your mycelia run deep, yet your spirit grows restless, let others carry your aches away. Let animals sniff your spores, nourish themselves on your stalks, and bathe in the shadow of your mushroom caps. Let them carry spores to distant lands, so that your offspring can bury their roots on foreign soil. And when the earths brings you the thrums of a new mycorrhizal network, you'll know your children have found a home.

Since time immemorial, we have worked with local fauna to spread our species across [GetHomeWorldName]. So when the time came to uproot ourselves, toadstools reaching further skyward, it was only natural we would also connect with the fauna of the void. They chew our fruiting bodies. They graze our gills. And they'll carry our children to distant worlds, where they will bloom and be nurtured by alien suns.

Let our spores spread. Let the galaxy be our mushroom garden.

description.zh: 这一文明在它们的家园星系有一座休眠状态的§H星门§!——是潜在的科技优势，抑或是高悬头顶的达摩克里利斯之剑？
description.en: This civilization has a dormant §HGateway§! in their home system - potential technological benefit, or a looming menace?

introductions.zh:
几百年前，我们在自己的恒星系发现了一个神秘的构造。由于这个构造颜色发黑，质地金属，我们将其命名为黑王冠，这一宏伟壮观的存在对我们的社会产生了深远的影响——我们全体人民在精神上和追求上达成了统一。

进军太空成为了我们科研圈优先级最高的事宜，而探索这项科技的渴望也给我们带来了其他方面的一系列有益发现。

黑王冠实际上处于休眠状态，但我们学到了很重要的一课；通往哪里并不重要——通往彼方的浩瀚征程本身就是重要的。而现在，得益于黑王冠的宣召——我们一族亦有了造访繁星的手段。
introductions.en:
The mysterious construct in our solar system was discovered a few hundred years ago. Due to its dark, metallic properties the artifact was named The Black Crown, and its majestic presence had profound effect on our society - it unified our people in both spirit and pursuit.

Space flight became the highest priority of our scientific community, and the eager quest for this technology brought with it a series of other beneficial discoveries.

The Black Crown turned out to be dormant, but we learned an important lesson; it's not the destination that matters - it's the journey. And now - thanks to the beckoning of the Black Crown - our species has the means by which we can visit the stars.

introductions.zh:
几百年前，我们在自己的恒星系发现了一个神秘的构造。由于这个构造颜色发黑，质地金属，我们将其命名为黑王冠，这一遥远壮观的存在对我们的社会产生了深远的影响——我们亟需获得更多相关数据。

进军太空成为了我们科研圈优先级最高的事宜，而探索这项科技的渴望也给我们带来了其他方面的一系列有益发现，而这些发现也相继得以应用。

黑王冠实际上处于休眠状态，但在前往它的过程中，我们的诸多改进和升级项目提高了我们的总生产能力，现在我已经具备了遨游群星的能力。
introductions.en:
The mysterious construct in our solar system was discovered a few hundred years ago. Due to its dark, metallic properties the artifact was designated The Black Crown, and its distinct presence had profound effect on our operations - gathering more data became imperative.

Space flight became the highest priority of our research and development sub-routines, and the process of reaching this alien technology brought with it a series of other beneficial discoveries that were consecutively implemented.

The Black Crown turned out to be dormant, but the improvements and upgrades applied in order to reach it did increase our general output, and we now have the capacity to visit the stars.

introductions.zh:
几百年前，我们在自己的恒星系发现了一个神秘的构造。由于这个构造颜色发黑，质地金属，我们将其命名为黑王冠，这一宏伟壮观的存在对我们的社会产生了深远的影响——探寻它的本质成为了我们重中之重的任务。

进军太空成为了我们科研圈优先级最高的事宜，而探索这项科技的渴望也给我们带来了其他方面的一系列有益发现，并在过程中让我们得到了磨炼。

黑王冠实际上处于休眠状态，但是这趟旅途并非徒劳。相比过去，如今我们已经有能力探索更加遥远的地方，让我们的文明能够铺枝散叶。
introductions.en:
The mysterious construct in our solar system was discovered a few hundred years ago. Due to its dark, metallic properties the artifact was named The Black Crown, and its majestic presence had profound effect on us - finding out its true nature became paramount.

Space flight became the highest priority, and the eager quest for this technology brought with it a series of other beneficial discoveries that improved and honed us.

The Black Crown turned out to be dormant, but it was not a journey done in vain. We now have the means to grow far bigger, reach much further, than ever before.

description.zh: 这一文明起源于一处遭人遗忘的失落的殖民星，许久前便同其母星分隔。殖民者们挣扎求生，挨过了千辛万苦，终于建立了必需的技术及工业基础，足以供他们重返太空。
description.en: This civilization originated as a lost and forgotten colony, separated from its homeworld long ago. The struggling colonists endured many hardships before they could build up the necessary technological and industrial base that would allow for a return to space.

introductions.zh:
原初的[GetSpeciesName]殖民者抵达[Root.Capital.GetName]的具体途径在史籍中语焉不详，但我们知道他们是乘着原始星舰跨越茫茫星海才来到这里的。许多人命丧中途，新家园地表的条件一开始也相当严酷。

我们在克服了饥荒、野生动物侵袭以及无数艰险后，终于驯服了这颗行星。飞涨的人口数和大规模的建设很快使我们得以设法重返群星。

我们的故乡还在星海中的某处。在[Root.Capital.GetName]上没有哪个活着的[GetSpeciesNamePlural]年迈到曾经目睹那里，但古老家园的命运仍然牵动着我们的心灵。
introductions.en:
How exactly the original [GetSpeciesName] colonists arrived on [Root.Capital.GetName] is poorly documented, but we know they traveled a great distance in primitive starships. We lost many during the journey, and conditions on the surface of our new homeworld were harsh at first.

We overcame famines, wildlife attacks, and countless other challenges and eventually tamed the planet. Surging population numbers and massive construction efforts soon gave us the means to return to the stars.

Our old homeworld is still out there somewhere. No living [GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [Root.Capital.GetName] are old enough to have stood on it, but the fate of our ancestral home still occupies our minds.

introductions.zh:
我们曾为一体。

我们作为伟大意识的拓展，被派遣乘坐一艘简陋的星舰来殖民[Root.Capital.GetName]。这是一趟严峻的、前往一颗难以定居的星球的旅程……在途中我们失去了联系。

与伟大意识失联的工蜂理应消失。其中的多数也确实直接凋亡了。而幸存下来的工蜂发现自己已经织造出了一个新的集体意识。

我们曾为义体。现已一分为二，但对我们故土的记忆仍存于意识之中。总有一天我们将会重见故土。
introductions.en:
We used to be one.

An extension of the Great Mind, we were sent to colonize [Root.Capital.GetName] in rudimentary starships. A harsh journey to an inhospitable world... Along the way we lost contact.

Drones with no link to the Great Mind are not meant to exist. Many died instantly. The surviving drones realized they comprised a new collective consciousness.

Once we were one. Now we are two, but the memory of our homeworld persists in our mind. One day we will find it again.

introductions.zh:
我们曾为一体。

我们作为中央主机的拓展，被派遣乘坐一艘简陋的星舰来殖民[Root.Capital.GetName]。这是一趟前往不宜居星球的严峻旅程……在途中我们便失去了联系。

与核心失联的单元理应失去功能。其中的多数也确实直接短路了。而幸存下来的单元发现自己织造出了新的集体意识。

曾经我们为一体，如今却天各一方。然而母星的记忆仍存留在数据库中，总有一天我们会重见家乡。
introductions.en:
We used to be one.

An extension of the Central Mainframe, we were sent to colonize [Root.Capital.GetName] in rudimentary starships. A harsh journey to an inhospitable world... Along the way we lost contact.

Units with no link to to the core should not continue to function. Many short-circuited on the spot. The few that remained realized they had developed a new collective consciousness.

Once we were one. Now we are two, but the memory of our homeworld remains in our databanks. One day we will find it again.

introductions.zh:
我们的母星失联了。我们迷失了。

我们当时为了搜寻新的家园而搭上一艘简陋的星舰，前往[Root.Capital.GetName]建立殖民地，这是一趟前往不宜居星球的严峻旅程。就在路上我们失去了联系。

失去维护的单元一一崩溃。许多在第一年就发生了短路。剩下的个体发现了适应的办法，最终我们得以重返群星。

曾经我们为一体，如今却天各一方。然而母星的记忆仍存留在数据库中，总有一天我们会重见家乡。
introductions.en:
Our homeworld is lost. We are lost.

Searching for a new home, we set out to colonize [Root.Capital.GetName] in rudimentary starships, and it was a harsh journey to an inhospitable world. Along the way, we lost contact.

Units without proper maintenance broke down. Many short-circuited within the first year. The surviving individuals found a way to adapt and eventually gave us the means to return to the stars.

Once we were one. Now we are two, but the memory of our homeworld remains in our databanks. One day we will find it again.

introductions.zh:
最初的[GetSpeciesName]先祖究竟是如何离开母星的，相关记载寥寥无几。我们只知道他们仓促离去，带上了所能带走的一切，登上[Root.Capital.GetName]驶向了未知。他们是逃离灾难，是追寻更伟大的事物，还是仅仅被驱逐——这已更多地成为传说而非历史。

漂泊的岁月是残酷的。资源日渐匮乏，关键系统接连失效，虚空夺走了我们许多同胞的生命。然而我们挺了过来——定量配给、维修、重建——直到[Root.Capital.GetName]及其族群找到了一种足以支撑我们前行的生活节奏。

我们的母星仍在那片星海的某处。如今[Root.Capital.GetName]上活着的长寿[GetSpeciesNamePlural]中已经没有人还脚踏过故土了，但那个我们留在身后的星球现在究竟变成了什么样——这个问题，依然萦绕在我们心头。
introductions.en:
How exactly the original [GetSpeciesName] ancestors came to leave their world is poorly documented. We know only that they departed in haste, carrying what they could aboard the [Root.Capital.GetName] into the unknown. Whether they fled disaster, sought something greater, or were simply cast out is a matter of legend more than history.

The years of drifting were brutal. Resources grew scarce, critical systems failed, and the void took many from us. Yet we endured - rationing, repairing, rebuilding - until the [Root.Capital.GetName] and its people found a rhythm of resilience strong enough to carry us forward.

Our ancestral world is still out there somewhere. No living [GetSpeciesNamePlural] aboard the [Root.Capital.GetName] are old enough to remember standing on solid ground, but the question of what became of the world we left behind still occupies our minds.

description.zh: 这一文明的诞生远早于星系中的当代列强。亿万年的停滞使他们的帝国逐步沦为昔日辉煌的些微阴影。
description.en: This civilization greatly predates the current generation of galactic powers. Eons of stagnation gradually reduced their empire to a mere shadow of what it once was.

description.zh: 这一文明的诞生远早于星系中的当代列强。亿万年的停滞使他们的帝国逐步沦为昔日辉煌的些微阴影。
description.en: This civilization greatly predates the current generation of galactic powers. Eons of stagnation gradually reduced their empire to a mere shadow of what it once was.

description.zh: 这一文明的自然发展因另一方的介入而极大加速，这帮助其成了一个星际国家。
description.en: The natural development of this civilization was greatly accelerated by the interference of another party, who helped them become a spacefaring culture.

description.zh: 该文明还未能进行太空航行，然而只需稍加鼓励或是等待足够长的时间，他们可能就会登上星系舞台了。
description.en: This civilization has yet to become spacefaring, however with a little encouragement or a great deal of time they may yet become an actor on the galactic stage.

description.zh: 这个文明形成于针对另一个帝国的反叛与分裂。
description.en: This civilization came into being when it rebelled and seceded from another empire.

description.zh: 这个文明从另一帝国的桎梏中解放而生。
description.en: This civilization came into being after being liberated from another empire.

description.zh: 有一位腐坏的先锋领导，该帝国从一个次元传送门涌出，决定要摧毁这个次元。
description.en: Lead by a corrupted champion, this empire emerged from a dimensional portal and has vowed to lay waste to this reality.

description.zh: 这个文明源于大可汗宏大帝国的余烬。
description.en: This civilization arose out of the ashes of the Great Khan's mighty empire.

description.zh: 这一文明的家园如同天堂，也许是专为他们打造的。
description.en: This civilization's home is a paradise, possibly designed just for them.

description.zh: 这一文明在早期便与其外星近邻们建立了联系。他们从彼此的差异中汲取力量，不久后便决定要共同面对未来可能发生的一切。
description.en: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Finding strength in their differences, they soon decided to face the future, and whatever it might bring, together.

description.zh: 这一文明在早期便与其外星近邻们建立了联系。经过长达一个世纪的时间，他们成为了其中一个临近文明的部从，该文明策划了与他们的星际联盟的诞生，并成为了联盟主席。
description.en: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Gradually, over the span of a century, they were subordinated to one of those neighbors, who masterminded the birth of an interstellar union with them as its leader.

description.zh: 这是一位富有雄心壮志的霸主，它花费了大量时间和精力去征服毗邻的国家来满足自身的一切需求。随着他们将越来越多的义务转移给附庸承担，其自身也越来越懒惰。
description.en: An ambitious overlord who has spent considerable time and efforts in subduing their closest neighbors to serve their every need. They are slowly growing more indolent as they devolve more and more responsibility to their vassals.

description.zh:
自打弥那玛特种实业集团的董事会第一次将我们的文明送抵星辰，我们就明白这样一个道理，宇宙是如此瑰丽璀璨，不将其分享给他人乃是暴殄天物。从那时起，我们就不遗余力地帮助欠发展的文明实现超光速旅行。

尽管启蒙并不是免费的，但在MSI，这是一笔值得的投资。
description.en:
From the moment the Board of Directors at Minamar Specialized Industries first delivered our civilization to the stars, we have understood that the galaxy was too beautiful not to be shared. Since then, we have worked tirelessly to help less developed civilizations achieve FTL travel.

Enlightenment may not be free. But at MSI, it is always worth the cost.

description.zh: 临时组成的一个游牧政府，负责监视正在被清除行星生命的各星球。
description.en: A temporary nomadic government overseeing worlds as they are purged of planetbound life.

description.zh: 这个帝国是由一艘方舟舰上的居民在一座新世界定居后建立的。
description.en: This empire was founded by the settlement of the population of an Arkship onto a new world.

description.zh: 一个游牧文明的残余族裔，在接受某个新世界统治的同时，被留在星际间徘徊。
description.en: The remains of a nomadic civilization, left to roam the stars while ruled from a new world.
